description: Staza snage is a trail race in the beautiful natural surroundings of Adžine Livade, for runners who want to push their limits and experience challenging terrain. The race has two courses: Prkos, 17.5 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain, and Zamah, 8 km with 450 m of elevation gain. The course combines steep climbs and technical descents down water channels, requiring sure footing, concentration, and courage. At the finish, the winner is not the fastest runner, but the one who has conquered the course and its strength. The race starts on April 25, 2026, in Adžine Livade: the longer course starts at 10:00 and the shorter one at 10:30.
course_highlights: Prkos course: 17.5 km with 1,000 m of elevation gain (5%+-)
Zamah course: 8.0 km with 450 m of elevation gain (5%+-)
Technical descents down water channels requiring sure footing and concentration
additional: Each participant receives a race pack with a race number and chip, a T-shirt, refreshments at checkpoints and the finish, a marked course, a GPX track, and a finisher medal. No additional registration is available after registration closes or on race day. Course distances: 17.5 km and 8 km; elevation gain up to 1,000 m; technical terrain; registration via the MyRace.rs platform. Race packs include T-shirts, medals, and a marked course.

name: 4. Jablanik Trail
description: Jablanik Trail is a UTMB Index race held in Valjevo, Serbia. The race is 34 kilometres long with a total elevation gain of 1,837 metres, offering runners challenging and attractive terrain. The course provides a unique opportunity to experience the natural beauty of western Serbia through its mountainous landscapes. The race brings together experienced runners and trail-running enthusiasts, creating a competitive and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course distance: 34 km
Total elevation gain: 1,837 metres
Mountain terrain in western Serbia
additional: Early registration offers discounts before 25 March 2026, and the race is part of a series of events promoting nature and outdoor activities in the region.

name: Антеа рън
description: Antea Run is a unique race combining 23 km of running with natural and artificial obstacles in the scenic area around Sozopol. It’s not just a marathon, but a challenge for anyone who wants to push their limits and enjoy beautiful nature and varied terrain. The event attracts running and adventure enthusiasts looking for something more than an ordinary race.
course_highlights: 23 km of running with natural and artificial obstacles
Scenic area around Sozopol
A combination of running and overcoming challenges

name: Асеновградски Баири
description: Asenovgrad Hills is a race and festival that combines sport and outdoor fun in the natural surroundings of Asenovgrad and the Rhodope Mountains. The event features mountain running and cycling, held on two separate days, giving participants and guests the chance to enjoy the region’s nature and landmarks. Organized by the Asenovgrad Hills Association, the race offers a range of distances for runners and cyclists, suitable for different ages and fitness levels. Participation requires good physical fitness and appropriate equipment, and the event is aimed at people who enjoy sport and nature.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with checkpoints and time limits for the longer distances
Running and cycling events held on two separate days
Opportunity to visit local landmarks and enjoy evening entertainment between the event days
additional: The race includes children’s starts over short distances, cut-off times, and stops at set kilometre points for the long runs (47 km and 80 km). Cycling distances range from 0.5 km to 60 km. The event takes place at Acad. N. Haytov Square in Asenovgrad. Participants should be prepared for mountain conditions and risks, including fatigue and bad weather. The events include mountain running and cycling over various distances; participation is subject to rules covering equipment and physical fitness. Online registration is available, with different participant categories.

name: Национален шампионат 10 000м - писта
description: The National 10,000-Metre Track Championship in Hisarya is a prestigious competition organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The championship brings together Bulgaria’s top athletes to compete over the classic 10-kilometre track distance. The event is part of the federation’s 2026 sports calendar and highlights the traditions and development of athletics in Bulgaria.
course_highlights: A track race over the classic 10,000 m distance
Held in the city of Hisarya
Part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation’s national sports calendar
additional: The first national 10,000 m track championship in Hisarya is included in the 2026 sports calendar.

name: Студентско бягане "UNIRUN"
description: UNIRUN is a student running event in Sofia that connects sport with a social cause, supporting youth sports and no-kill shelters. The event takes place in West Park and offers four distances of varying difficulty, from 1 km to the 21 km half marathon. Participants join a community that inspires movement, healthy living, and social engagement, while enjoying music, games, and prizes. The run is accompanied by festival activities and opportunities for personal development and social interaction.
course_highlights: Course: 50% asphalt and 50% gravel park paths
Aid stations at different kilometer points depending on the distance
Festival village with interactive tents and music
additional: Race bib pickup is available April 21–23, from 9:00 to 19:00, in the South Wing of the Rectorate. Each distance has an official warm-up and awards ceremony. Games, raffles, opportunities for social interaction, and professional feedback are included. Official T-shirts and other merchandise support youth sports. Distances: 1 km, 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km; support for social causes such as helping children with cerebral palsy and animals; an event with an active community and many prizes.

name: Semimaraton Iași
organizer: Rotary Club Iași Copou, Salvați Copiii Iași, Primăria Municipiului Iași

price_tiers.distance: Cursa populară, Cursa copiilor, Cursa persoanelor cu dizabilități

description: Semimaraton Iași este cel mai mare eveniment de alergare din Nord-Estul României, desfășurat anual în Piața Palatului Culturii. Traseul semimaratonului constă în două bucle cu trecere prin zona de start, oferind alergătorilor o experiență unică pe străzile principale ale orașului, cu oprirea circulației auto și puncte de revitalizare. Evenimentul are o puternică componentă caritabilă, susținând copii din medii defavorizate prin proiecte educaționale și sociale. Participarea la cursele de semimaraton, cros și curse populare este o ocazie de a face o faptă bună și de a face parte dintr-o comunitate dedicată schimbării pozitive.
course_highlights: Traseu pe străzi principale cu oprirea circulației auto
Trecere prin fața Palatului Culturii
Puncte de revitalizare pentru hidratare și asistență medicală
additional: Participanții la cursele de semimaraton, cros 10 km și cros 5 km primesc cip de unică folosință și tricou tehnic de participare. Înscrierile se pot face online până la data limită, iar după aceasta, în funcție de locurile disponibile, se pot face înscrieri offline la insula Semimaraton Iași din Palas Mall. Nu se pot face înscrieri în ziua concursului. Evenimentul oferă ambulanță pentru asistență medicală și multe fotografii la finish și pe traseu. Participarea include puncte de hidratare, asistență medicală, kit de participare și posibilitatea de a participa online sau offline. Evenimentul are scop caritabil, susținând proiecte pentru copiii defavorizați.

name: URME PE PLAY
price_range: prima înscriere este gratuită, alte detalii nu sunt specificate
description: Urme pe Play este o competiție de alergare montană ce se desfășoară în comuna Rășinari, la poalele munților Cindrel și Lotru. Traseele sunt marcate și includ poteci naturale, drumuri forestiere și asfalt, oferind o experiență submontană autentică. Evenimentul este deschis atât adulților, cât și copiilor, cu curse dedicate pentru fiecare categorie de vârstă. Participanții se pot bucura de peisaje pitorești și de atmosfera prietenoasă a comunității locale în cadrul unui eveniment ce combină sportul cu cultura și tradiția locală.
course_highlights: Trasee pe poteci marcate în Rășinari și dealurile de la poalele munților Cindrel și Lotru
Suprafață variată: asfalt, drum forestier, poteci naturale și pășuni
Peisaje pitorești de primăvară la poalele munților
additional: Participarea se face pe proprie răspundere, cu semnarea unei declarații de responsabilitate. Vârsta minimă este 14 ani pentru cursa Fuguț și 18 ani pentru Cros, Semi, Maraton și Ultra Maraton. Copiii sub 14 ani pot participa la curse dedicate. Pachetul de înscriere nu se expediază prin poștă. Organizatorul poate interzice startul sau continuarea cursei în caz de stare fizică necorespunzătoare. Evenimentul include și activități culturale, drumeții și târg cu produse locale, fiind o oportunitate de a descoperi tradițiile și frumusețea zonei Rășinari.

name: IX. Miklósi Futónap
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 8 km, 3.5 km, 1 km, 0.8 km, 0.5 km
description: The 9th Miklósi Running Day is a family-friendly running race in Szigetszentmiklós, taking place on April 26, 2026. It offers several distances, from 500 metres up to the half marathon (21 km). The event starts in front of the City Sports Hall and follows the Szebeni Road, Petőfi Road and Gerincút route before returning to the sports hall. Changing rooms, a cloakroom and toilets are available at the venue. The race aims to promote sport and community for all age groups.
course_highlights: Route starts in front of and returns to the City Sports Hall
Szebeni Road – Petőfi Road – Gerincút route
Distances: 500 m, 800 m, 1,000 m, 3.5 km, 8 km, 21 km (half marathon)
additional: Race-pack pickup and the information point are located at the entrance to the City Sports Hall. Changing rooms, a cloakroom and toilets are available in the sports hall. There is no on-site registration or in-person late registration on race day. Registration is online only, with payment by bank card through the Barion system. Children under 6 may enter the 500 m distance only when accompanied by an adult. The organizers may limit the number of participants. The event offers categories for several age groups and types of runners; online registration is required to participate. The event includes timing, refreshment stations and parking.

name: III. Strázsa-hegyi Trail Futóverseny 2 / 5 / 10 / 21
location: Monor, Strázsahegyi dűlő, Pest County, Hungary
description: The III Strázsa-hegyi Toyota Kovács Trail Running Race will take place on April 26, 2026, in the Strázsahegyi dűlő area of Monor. Participants can choose from a 500-meter family run, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and half-marathon distances. Runners can tackle the courses on varied terrain in a nature-rich setting. The event aims to promote a love of sport and nature in a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Nature-rich trail routes around Monor
10 km and half-marathon distances available
A 500-meter family run for the youngest participants
additional: Entries are accepted until April 12. GPX maps of the 10 km and half-marathon routes are available on the race’s official website. Online registration is available, and the event welcomes participants with local food and wine in a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: STRÁZSA-HEGYI TRAIL
location: Szent Orbán tér, Monor, Pest County, Hungary
description: The III Strázsa-hegy Toyota Kovács Trail Running Race will take place on April 26, 2026, at Szent Orbán Square in Monor. For the third time, runners will test their strength on varied terrain around scenic Strázsa Hill. The race offers a challenge for all participants in a welcoming atmosphere and a natural setting. The event celebrates sport and community, and welcomes running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Natural surroundings and varied terrain around Strázsa Hill
Challenging trail running routes
Start location: Szent Orbán Square, Monor
additional: The race will take place on April 26, 2026, from 08:00 to 15:00 at Szent Orbán Square in Monor. It is part of the Toyota Kovács Trail Running Race series and will be held for the third time. The event provides chip timing, free bus services, and parking. The registration deadline is April 12.

name: ÍROTTKŐ HILLCLIMB
location: Kőszeg Rőtfalva, Kőszeg, Vas County, Hungary
description: The Írottkő Hillclimb is a varied and memorable mountain running race, taking place on April 26, 2026, near Rőtfalva in Kőszeg. The race has a new start location in Bozsok and offers runners several distances, from a 7 km introductory trail run to the 102 km Alpokalja Ultra. The courses take participants across varied terrain, with beautiful views and aid stations, and require stamina and good physical preparation. The race also offers family-friendly activities, so even the youngest visitors can enjoy nature-conservation and interactive exhibitions.
course_highlights: A new start location in Bozsok as the race continues to evolve
A 23 km distance with 780 metres of elevation gain and wonderful views from the summit of Írottkő
The 102 km Alpokalja Ultra, taking in the most spectacular spots in the Kőszeg Mountains
additional: The race starts from a new location in Bozsok, and the course has several aid stations and water-refill points. The 23 km distance includes 780 metres of elevation gain, with panoramic views from the summit of Írottkő. The 102 km distance can also be completed as a team, making the shared finish a special experience. The youngest visitors can enjoy an interactive exhibition and nature-conservation activities. The race is semi-self-supported, and runners must carry mandatory equipment, such as a mobile phone, a water container, a windproof or rain jacket, a headlamp and a spare battery. The race showcases the natural beauty of the Kőszeg Mountains across varied terrain, with a new start in Bozsok, and offers people of different ages and ability levels the opportunity to take part.

name: FUTAPEST TEREPFUTÁS
description: The Futapest Terepfutás Bér race is an exciting trail-running event held in the scenic surroundings of Bér, Virágospuszta. Runners can test their strength on varied routes close to nature, enjoying its beauty and the challenging terrain. The race is organized by Futapest Klub, which has supported trail running and cross-country running in Hungary for many years. All runners are warmly welcome to join this friendly, community-focused event.
course_highlights: Varied terrain close to nature around Bér, Virágospuszta
Challenging hilly sections and forest trails
Scenic landscape and fresh air for runners
additional: The race offers several distances and is intended for people who enjoy nature and sport. Detailed information is available on the website.

name: Takovski grm
description: Takovski Grm is a 13.5 km road race taking place on April 26, 2026, starting in Takovo and finishing in Gornji Milanovac. The race runs through Takovo’s historic natural surroundings and along a newly opened route, with plenty of uphill and downhill sections, offering both a challenge and the pleasure of enjoying the natural beauty. The organizers invite runners to take part and enjoy running together, the results, and socializing at the finish. All participants who complete the race receive a finisher’s medal, while the top runners are awarded cash prizes and trophies.
course_highlights: A 13.5 km road race starting in Takovo and finishing in Gornji Milanovac
A route through Takovo’s historic natural surroundings and along a newly opened trail
Significant uphill and downhill sections
additional: Race-pack pickup from 7:00 to 8:30 in Gornji Milanovac. Organized transport to the start in Takovo at 8:30. Refreshments during and after the race. Awards ceremony at 12:30 in central Gornji Milanovac. Participants run at their own risk. The event includes timekeeping, medals, T-shirts, and other logistical arrangements for participants.

name: Pancharevo Trail Marathon
description: Pancharevo Trail Marathon is Bulgaria’s largest spring mountain running event, held near Pancharevo Lake. The race offers three distances: a 42 km marathon with 1,700 m of elevation gain, a 21 km half marathon with 700 m of elevation gain, and a beginner-friendly 10 km race, as well as a 15 km mountain hike. The courses pass through the scenic Lozen Mountain, with views of Vitosha, the Balkan Mountains, Rila, and Iskar Reservoir. The event is organized by Begach Sports Club and attracts more participants every year.
course_highlights: 42 km marathon with 1,700 m of elevation gain through Lozen Mountain
21 km half marathon with 700 m of elevation gain to Mount Bachun
10 km courses with around 100 m of elevation gain, suitable for beginners
additional: Race kits can be collected on the Thursday and Friday before the race in Sofia. There are aid stations and medical assistance along the courses. The race provides no cups, so participants must bring their own bottle or cup for water. A bag drop is available, but the organizers are not responsible for lost belongings. Free parking is available in Pancharevo. Medical teams are stationed at the start, Pasarel, and Lalina Mogila. Participants must wear their race bib on their chest or abdomen. Multiple race categories, including mountain running and hiking; an event focused on nature and social activities; date: April 26, 2026.

name: XL kmrun - Банкя
description: XL Bankya is a new race on the XLkmrun calendar, held in the foothills of Lyulin Mountain near Sofia. The course is shaped like a figure eight, starting on the northern outskirts of Bankya and heading toward Ostra Chuka Peak. Participants can choose between two distances: 6.4 km with 217 m of elevation gain, or 12.8 km. The course offers challenges for mountain-running enthusiasts. The race is part of the XLkmrun series, which features a variety of courses and distances in Sofia and other cities.
course_highlights: The figure-eight course starts on the northern outskirts of Bankya
Each loop is 6.4 km long with 217 m of elevation gain
Choose one or two loops (6.4 km or 12.8 km)
additional: The course was designed by Miroslav Spasov. The race is held at the site of a spring relay. Part of the 5kmrun calendar, alongside other events in Sofia and across the country. Race in the foothills of Lyulin Mountain, date 2026-04-26

name: Бистрица Вертикал Рън
description: Bistritsa Vertical Run is a scenic and challenging race that starts in the village of Bistritsa, which is accessible by public transport. The course crosses varied terrain with gradual but demanding climbs, reaching the Kikish area, with panoramic views of Sofia. The route continues to Kamen Del Hut, where participants can refuel with food and drinks. This race is excellent strength and endurance training, suitable for preparing for long distances and mountain running.
course_highlights: Start in the village of Bistritsa, with easy access by bus No. 98
Gradual but demanding climb with 500 m of elevation gain to the Kikish area
Panoramic views of Sofia and an opportunity to rest and refuel at Kamen Del Hut
additional: The route features varied surfaces, from forest trails to rocky sections, helping runners adapt to different conditions. In the Kikish area, the shelter offers cover and food on weekends. Running in nature provides a chance to recover away from the noise of the city. Terrain, marathon preparation, natural setting

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване за мъже и жени и юноши и девойки под 20 г.
description: The National Mountain Running Uphill Championship for men, women, under-20 boys and under-20 girls takes place on April 26, 2026, in Bistritsa village, Sofia. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation calendar and offers a challenging uphill mountain race for different age groups. The organizers provide official registration and support for competitors; communication is handled directly with them. The event is a tradition and attracts athletes looking for a competitive experience on mountain terrain.
course_highlights: Uphill mountain race in the area of Bistritsa village, Sofia
Competition for men, women, under-20 boys and under-20 girls
Held under the auspices of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation
additional: Contacting the organizer is recommended for any questions. The competition is part of the national mountain running championship and takes place in Bistritsa village, Sofia. It is part of the national mountain running series, focuses on uphill running, and offers participation opportunities for different age groups.

name: Etyekrun
organizer: RUNaway Sportszervező Kft. és Etyek Trend
description: EtyekRUN is a unique running race in the rolling hills of Etyek, where the atmosphere of the wine region, its vineyards, rows of vines and spring scenery accompany participants every step of the way. The race is part of the Garmin WTF series, which celebrates the joy of movement and the diversity of athletic achievements, with both shorter road distances and longer trail-running routes. The event is family-friendly, and sustainability, consistency and enjoyment are at the heart of the community. Participants will have a unique experience amid the beauty of nature and the wine region.
course_highlights: A route through the rolling hills of Etyek, among rows of vines and vineyards
Spring scenery and the atmosphere of the wine region
Mixed terrain: road and trail running
additional: Discounted family registration is available, allowing one adult to register up to 5 family members. Family registration does not include a medal by default, but one can be ordered for an additional fee. Registration cannot be cancelled, but it can be transferred to another race no later than 21 days before the event. The registration system automatically sends an invoice, and several payment methods are available. The Garmin WTF series puts sustainability and a sense of community first. Participants can choose from several distances, and free Pilates classes, local wines and food will be available in connection with the event. The race is an ideal event for lovers of vineyards and nature.

name: XI. Ezerjó Félmaraton 5 / 10 / 21
location: Mór, Szent István tér, Mór, Hungary
description: The 11th Ezerjó Half Marathon will take place on May 1, 2026, in Mór, at Szent István Square. The event offers three distances: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km). Runners can take on the routes through beautiful vineyards across varied terrain, with climbs and panoramic views. The event is family-friendly and also welcomes younger participants with children’s races. Finishers are rewarded with refreshments and a finisher’s medal. The event’s distinctive atmosphere comes from the local wine region and the sense of community.
course_highlights: 5 km route within Mór, with minimal elevation gain on easy terrain
10 km route through vineyards, following a hilly and varied course
21 km half marathon with long climbs, views of Csókakő Castle, and downhill sections
additional: The start area is in front of Mór Town Hall. Start times: half marathon at 10:00, 5 km at 10:05, and 10 km at 10:10. The entry fee includes participation, a finisher’s medal, chip timing, refreshments, a fröccs station, coffee, and ice cream at the finish. The race is cup-free as part of its commitment to environmental protection. Children’s races will also take place in Szent István Park, with separate age groups and awards. The half marathon uses chip timing, with a UHF chip attached to the back of the race bib. Technical and cotton T-shirts can be ordered for an additional fee during advance registration. Scenery: park and city streets. Advance registration is open until April 20; on-site registration is available at higher fees. Children’s races. A finisher’s medal is not guaranteed for on-site registrations.

name: 50. Komárom-Komárno Nemzetközi Utcai Futóverseny
location: Komárom, Szabadság tér, Komárom-Esztergom megye, Hungary
description: The 50th Komárom-Komárno International Street Race is a traditional international running event held in two countries within one city. Participants can choose between 5.5 km and 10 km races, as well as a children’s race. The event is open to both competitive and recreational runners. The race starts at Szabadság Square in South Komárom and finishes at the sports hall in North Komárom. Its aims are to promote running, strengthen the running community, and support a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The course runs through the streets of North and South Komárom, crossing two countries within one city
5.5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a 200-metre children’s race
The finish is at the sports hall in North Komárom
additional: Race-pack collection is available on race day: by 9:15 at the latest for the 10 km race and by 9:45 for the 5.5 km race. The children’s race is for participants aged 10 or younger. The time limits are 1 hour 30 minutes for the 10 km race and 45 minutes for the 5.5 km race. The awards ceremony takes place at 11:30 at the sports hall in North Komárom. The participant limit is 1,500. Several thousand people take part in the event, and registration is open until April 25. The race is part of the Komárom Days events and the course passes several points around the city, including the area around Szabadság Square and the North Komárom Municipal Sports Hall.

name: KOMÁROM – KOMÁRNO FUTÓVERSENY
description: The Komárom-Komárno International Street Running Race is an open, recreational running event held on the streets of the cities of North and South Komárom—two countries, one city. The event offers 5.5 km and 10 km distances, as well as children’s races, and welcomes both competitive and recreational runners. Its aim is to promote running, strengthen the sense of belonging to the running community, and support healthy living. The start is at Szabadság Square in South Komárom, and the finish is at the City Sports Hall in North Komárom. The event is a longstanding international tradition that also strengthens cooperation between the two cities.
course_highlights: Street course through the districts of North and South Komárom, in two countries
5.5 km and 10 km distances, plus children’s races
Start: Szabadság Square, South Komárom; finish: City Sports Hall, North Komárom
additional: Race-pack pickup on race day: by 9:45 at the latest for the 5.5 km distance and by 9:15 for the 10 km distance. The event aims to strengthen the running community and promote healthy living. The mayors of the two cities are the event’s patrons. Race directors and local race coordinators oversee the organization. The event takes place on May 1, 2026; registration is open, and detailed information is available on the official websites. The event brings together the local community and international runners.

name: FUT AZ ÜLLŐ
description: “Fut az Üllő” is a traditional urban running race held in the city center of Üllő. The race aims to promote sport and community life and is open to all age groups. A limited number of on-site registrations will also be available on race day from 7:00 a.m. The event is organized by the Municipality of Üllő, which ensures its success with the support of the local community.
course_highlights: Running course in the city center
Community-oriented, family-friendly event
On-site registration available on race day
additional: Online registration closes on April 26, 2024, at 12:00 p.m., but a limited number of on-site registrations will also be available on race day from 7:00 a.m. Race date: 2026-05-01; registration deadline: 2024-04-26; location: City Center, Üllő

name: Sălciua Trail Run
location: Sălciua de Jos, Alba County, Romania
description: Sălciua Trail Run 2026 este o competiție de alergare în natură desfășurată în comuna Sălciua, situată între Munții Trascău și Muntele Mare, oferind o priveliște spectaculoasă. Evenimentul reunește pasionați de alergare, natură, cultură și distracție, fiind o oportunitate de a evada din cotidian și de a te bucura de frumusețea naturii în compania celor dragi. Competiția include patru curse: Cursa Zmeilor (28 km), Crosul Liliecilor (15 km), Family and Young Run (5 km) și Cursa Spiridușilor (400-800 m), deschise tuturor participanților care respectă condițiile de vârstă și înscriere. Organizatorii asigură o experiență completă, cu kituri de concurs, festivitate de premiere și ateliere tematice pentru toate vârstele.
course_highlights: Trasee prin rezervații naturale, dealuri și pășuni
Zone cu cascade și peșteri unice în zonă
Cadru natural între Munții Trascău și Muntele Mare, altitudine 700-1400 m
additional: Predare kituri în ziua cursei între 07:00-08:30. Starturi în ordine: Crosul Liliecilor (15 km) la 09:00, Family and Young Run (5 km) la 09:30, Cursa Spiridușilor (400-800 m) la 10:00. Festivitatea de premiere începe la ora 13:00. Evenimentul include ateliere tematice pentru copii și adulți în momentele de pauză. Participarea include diverse categorii de curse, cu detalii despre condițiile de înscriere și program, toate programate pentru luna mai 2026.

name: Chindia City Race
location: Piața Tricolorului, Târgoviște, Dâmbovița County, Romania
description: Chindia City Race este o alergare tradițională organizată în inima Cetății Târgoviștei, chiar lângă emblematicul Turn al Chindiei. Evenimentul are loc pe 2 mai 2026, în Piața Tricolorului, și adună participanți de toate vârstele, într-o atmosferă de sărbătoare și competiție prietenoasă. Startul este programat la ora 10:00, iar cursa celebrează spiritul și istoria orașului, invitând alergătorii să-și testeze viteza și rezistența pe un traseu urban plin de energie și tradiție.
course_highlights: Startul în Piața Tricolorului, în centrul istoric al Târgoviștei
Traseu urban cu peisaje ale Cetății și Turnului Chindiei
Eveniment dedicat tuturor categoriilor de vârstă și niveluri de pregătire
additional: Zona de start este în Piața Tricolorului, Târgoviște. Evenimentul are o atmosferă festivă și este deschis tuturor, cu recomandarea de a veni cu încălțări adecvate și suflare zdravănă. Evenimentul face parte din Carpat Race și este susținut de comunitatea locală, fiind o oportunitate de a promova sănătatea și activitatea fizică în Târgoviște.

name: Még egy kört / Încă o rundă - Trail challenge
location: Világlátó, Sfântu Gheorghe, Covasna County, Romania
description: Még egy kört este o provocare de trail running ce are loc la marginea orașului Sfântu Gheorghe, într-un teren împădurit și deluros cunoscut sub numele de „Világlátó”. Participanții pot alege să alerge sau să practice Nordic Walking timp de 2, 4 sau 6 ore, încercând să parcurgă cât mai multe ture de 1,6 km cu o diferență de nivel de +60 m. Evenimentul este conceput ca o provocare mentală și fizică, oferind o atmosferă plăcută cu muzică și bar la fața locului. Este o oportunitate excelentă pentru iubitorii de alergare și nu numai să se testeze într-un cadru natural și prietenos.
course_highlights: Teren împădurit și deluros cunoscut ca „Világlátó”
Tură de 1,6 km cu +60 m diferență de nivel
Provocare de 2, 4 sau 6 ore cu opțiune Nordic Walking
additional: Se oferă bastoane pentru Nordic Walking în număr limitat, pe bază de cerere prin email. La fața locului va fi muzică și Wunderbar. Fiecare participant primește un pachet de start cu număr de concurs și alte materiale promoționale. Evenimentul este o combinație de alergare și provocare mentală, cu posibilitatea de a parcurge cât mai multe ture în intervalul ales. Trail challenge cu bucle de 1,6 km, opțiuni pentru alergare sau Nordic walking, parte a evenimentului Szent György Napok.

name: II. Mohácsi Gőcze Trail
description: The II Mohácsi Gőcze Trail is a recreational running event taking place on May 2, 2026, at the Szőlőhegyi event grounds in Mohács. The race follows the trails of the Mohács Hills and offers various distances for all age groups, from an 500-meter children’s race to a 22 km distance. The family-friendly event offers medical coverage and prizes, and participants can have their times recorded by chip timing. Runners can take part in a group warm-up before the start. Participation is at the runner’s own risk.
course_highlights: Trails of the Mohács Hills
Distances from 500 m to 22 km, for all age groups
Start and finish at the Szőlőhegyi event grounds
additional: Chip timing with a 2,000 Ft deposit. Prizes for the top three finishers in each distance and gender category. Participants in the children’s races receive a finisher’s medal. Register online and pay by bank transfer. Registration changes: fussajovodert@gmail.com. Littering is prohibited and may result in disqualification. The event may be postponed in extreme weather. Terrain: trails of the Mohács Hills; Registration: online, through the Facebook event; chip timing, prizes, medical coverage, children’s races

name: MOHÁCSI GÖCZE TRAIL (2.)
location: Mohácsi Szőlőhegyi rendezvénytér, Mohács, Baranya County, Hungary
description: The Mohács Gőcze Trail is a trail-running race held at the Mohács Szőlőhegyi Event Venue. Every finisher receives a metal finisher’s medal, and the top three finishers in each distance and gender category receive special prizes, including in the children’s races. The event promotes the power of running and community, and offers participants high quality at low prices. The race includes a 21 km distance that earns Ötpróba points. The organizers emphasize the positive effects of running on physical and mental health.
course_highlights: 21 km trail-running distance
Every finisher receives a metal finisher’s medal
The top three finishers in each distance and gender category receive special prizes
additional: On-site registration is available on race day. The race venue is the Mohács Szőlőhegyi Event Venue. The race is part of the Ötpróba program; the 21 km distance is worth 4 points. Children’s races also include prizes. Distances: 500 m, 1 km, 6 km, 10.5 km, 22 km; venue: Mohács, Szőlőhegyi Event Venue; online and on-site registration; medical coverage; children’s races; changes may be made depending on the weather.

name: MaricaRUN
description: MaricaRUN 2026 is a unique sporting event featuring 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as a 1 km children’s run, held in the beautiful Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad. The race combines sport, excitement, and a charitable cause, with 40% of entry fees donated to charity. The course is flat, suitable for everyone, and runs through the most beautiful parts of the park, with views of the Maritsa River. Participants will enjoy a well-organized course with refreshment stations and a festive atmosphere featuring prizes and sports demonstrations.
course_highlights: Flat course suitable for all levels
Runs alongside the Maritsa River and relaxation areas with water views
The 10 km course consists of 2 laps of the park
additional: Race packs can be collected in advance on May 1 from 18:00 to 20:00 or on race day. The starts are on May 2: 10 km at 10:00, 5 km at 10:15, and the 1 km children’s run at 10:20. The awards ceremony takes place after the race at 11:40. 40% of entry fees are donated to charity. Participants receive medals, while the winners receive cups, vouchers, and gifts. Sports demonstrations, physical challenges, and a prize raffle are planned. The course runs through Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad. Registration is online or on-site, and participants receive medals and the chance to win prizes. Places are limited.

name: Коджа Кая
location: село Билка, район връх Коджа Кая, България
description: Kodzha Kaya is the first fully self-supported ultramarathon in Bulgaria, held in the village of Bilka, in the area of Mount Kodzha Kaya. The race offers a range of distances with substantial elevation gain and no aid stations, making it a true test of endurance and skill. Participants are challenged to finish before sunset while enjoying stunning views and natural beauty. It is an event for adventure and mountain-running enthusiasts that leaves a lifelong memory.
course_highlights: 75 km with 4,400 m of elevation gain and full self-sufficiency
42 km marathon with over 2,700 m of elevation gain and no aid stations
30 km Sky with 1,950 m of elevation gain and full self-sufficiency
additional: All distances are fully self-supported, with no aid stations. There is also an additional challenge: a vertical climb up Kodzha Kaya, 3.6 km with 500 m of elevation gain. The event takes place in a natural setting rich in flora and fauna, offering stunning views and challenging terrain. The race is held on May 1–2, 2026, and participants can choose from a range of distances suitable for both experienced runners and enthusiasts. Registration is available on the official website.

name: МарицаРън 2026
location: Димитровград, Парк Марица, Димитровград, Хасково, България
description: Maritsa Run 2026 is a professionally organized race suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The event offers three distances: 1 km for children up to age 14, 5 km for a fun sporting challenge, and 10 km for a greater personal achievement. The course passes through the most beautiful parts of Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad, including its paths, the river, the relaxation area, and art installations. Participants will enjoy a great atmosphere with music, spectators, and support along the route, as well as prizes and recognition, with a prize fund of over 1500 euros.
course_highlights: The course passes through the main entrance, paths, river, relaxation area, and art installations of Maritsa Park
Distances: 1 km children’s race, 5 km and 10 km for adults
Hydration stations and support along the route
additional: Registration is available online or on site on the event day, subject to the availability of race bibs. Late registration is available after 15.04.2026. Medals for all finishers and cash and in-kind prizes for the winners. The event features music, professional photographers, and a festive atmosphere. Registration is online or on site, with late registration after 15.04. The event includes a children’s race and routes in Maritsa Park, supporting a healthy lifestyle and the community.

name: 24. Öntúlszárnyalás maraton
description: The 24th Self-Transcendence Marathon will take place on May 3, 2026, at Malomvölgyi Lake in Pécs. Organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, this family-friendly race follows a loop course and offers marathon and half-marathon distances. The course runs on compacted forest trails and crushed stone, with 30 meters of elevation gain, giving participants varied terrain to race on. Chip timing ensures accurate results, and the aid stations provide plenty of refreshments.
course_highlights: 5.2 km loop course; the marathon covers 8 laps
Compacted forest trails and crushed stone, with 30 meters of elevation gain
A combination of the walking path around the lake and a marked course
additional: Chip timing uses a chip attached to the back of the bib. The aid station at the start/finish offers isotonic drinks, water, sweet and savoury biscuits, sandwiches, fruit, vegetables and chocolate. Field limit: 250 participants. A T-shirt can be ordered separately for HUF 3,500 until April 15. Cut-off times: 5.2 km — 50 minutes; 10.4 km — 1 hour 40 minutes; half marathon — 3 hours; marathon — 6 hours. Bib and T-shirt collection is available on race day between 7:00 and 7:45; on-site registration is also available during this time. Multiple distances, a forest course, chip timing, on-site and online registration, a participant limit (max. 250), cut-off times and awards by distance, and nearby accommodation offers.

name: Farkasmályi Dűlő és Pince futás
organizer: Gyöngyösi Triatlon Klub, Farkasmályi Borpincék Egyesület
description: The Farkasmály Vineyard and Cellar Run is an atmospheric trail-running race along the vineyard slopes of Farkasmály in Gyöngyös, among vineyards and wine cellars. The event offers challenges over several distances, including a shorter, less hilly 3 km loop and a longer 8.5 km loop with climbs. Runners can enjoy being close to nature, visits to wine cellars, and varied terrain suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike. The event is organized by GYÖTRI Klub, which has decades of experience running sporting events.
course_highlights: Vineyard Loop: 3,000 m, 40 m elevation gain, 2 loops among the vineyard slopes, with a wine-cellar visit
Farkasmály Loop: 8,500 m, 190 m elevation gain, 4 loops with climbs and wine-cellar visits
Relay race: 4 × 1,500 m; Spritzer Run for teams of 3, with an 800 m distance and spritzer drinking stations
additional: Registration and bib pickup from 13:00; on-site registration closes 15 minutes before the start of the relevant race. Parking is available on the grassy area beside the Szilue Hotel. Race location GPS coordinates: 47.805908, 19.955025. Registration for the race is open from April 10 to April 30; prizes and a wine tasting await participants.

name: MÁSODSZOR IS CÉLBA ÉRÜNK!
description: Koraszülöttfutás 2026 is a charity running event that starts in Zalaegerszeg and finishes in Keszthely, covering a total distance of 66 km. Along the way, participants run through the beautiful landscapes of Zala County, with ten relay points, and the entire route is timed using chip timing. The event gives special support to premature babies, and includes a separate run for them. Teams can cross the finish line together to share the experience and the achievement. The start and pasta party venue is the Zala Zone Automotive Test Track. The run takes place on Sunday, May 3.
course_highlights: 66 km between Zalaegerszeg and Keszthely
10 relay points and a refreshment point at the Göcseji Village Museum
The route is marked with small teddy-bear signs and ribbons approximately every 200 metres
additional: Timing is provided by a chip attached to the race bib. The time limit for the distance is 8 hours 30 minutes. The pasta party takes place at the Zala Zone Automotive Test Track on May 2 at 17:00. The route also crosses two railway crossings; participants are escorted by an ambulance across the first one. The run for premature babies takes place on May 3 at 16:00, from the castle park in Keszthely to Fő tér. The event includes several related activities, including registration, race-pack collection, relay points and the finish, and offers the option to enter individually or as a team.

name: Mechi Chal Trail Chepelare
price_range: 15 € до 30 € за участие, 20 € за тениска на събитието
description: Mechi Chal Trail is an exciting mountain race taking place on May 3, 2026, in Chepelare, at Olympic Square. The courses follow mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains, suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The race offers three distances with varying elevation gain, challenging participants with a true mountain experience. Every finisher receives a medal, and the winners receive cash and in-kind prizes.
course_highlights: Mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains
Distances with positive elevation gain ranging from 420 m to 1,640 m
Start and finish at Olympic Square in Chepelare
additional: Race packets will be distributed on May 2 from 15:00 to 20:00 at Borika Hotel and on May 3 from 8:00 at Olympic Square. Participants under 16 may take part only in the 7.6 km distance. Every finisher receives a medal, and the prizes for the top three places are cash and in-kind prizes. Participants are advised to complete the participation declarations in advance. Payment is currently accepted only by bank transfer. The distances are 7.6 km, 15 km, and 30 km, with positive elevation gains of 420 m, 820 m, and 1,640 m, respectively; the start and finish are at Olympic Square in Chepelare; the courses run through mountain and forest terrain.

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване и спускане мъже и жени, под 20 г., под 18г., под 16г.
description: The National Mountain Running Championship—uphill and downhill—for men and women, as well as boys and girls under 20, under 18 and under 16, takes place in Chepelare. The competition offers challenging mountain terrain that tests participants’ endurance and skills. It is an important event in the Bulgarian athletics calendar, attracting both young and experienced runners. The organizers provide professional event management and support for all participants.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with uphill and downhill sections
Categories for men, women, and boys and girls under 20, 18 and 16
Held in the scenic area of Chepelare
additional: For any questions, participants should contact the organizer directly at the email address provided to them. The competition is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation calendar and is held with official support. It is part of the national mountain running calendar and offers the opportunity to compete in different age categories.

name: 10 дневно състезание „Шри Чинмой“
location: Парк „Св. Св. Петър и Павел“, София, България
description: The 10-day Sri Chinmoy race in Sofia is the first certified multi-day race in Bulgaria, held in St. Peter and Paul Park. The race takes place on a flat, certified 785-meter asphalt loop, with each participant competing to cover the greatest possible distance within 10 days. The event is organized with attention to detail, including official lap counting and strict rules for fairness and safety. Participants can enjoy the atmosphere of the race village and the support of the organizers and fellow competitors.
course_highlights: Flat, certified 785-meter asphalt loop
Held in St. Peter and Paul Park in Sofia
Minimum daily distance: 43.44 km (27 miles)
additional: Each race day starts at 8:00. Each participant must wear a visible race number on the front. Laps are counted by a judge, who changes every six hours. A camera-based backup counting system is also in place. If a participant pauses the race or leaves the course, they must inform the judge. A “hotel lap” may be counted when leaving and rejoining the course at designated points. Alcohol consumption, smoking, and drug use are prohibited in the camp and on the course. A minimum running dress code applies in the park, and running shirtless is not permitted. Official results are published the following day at around 9:00 on www.srichinmoyraces.bg. Course: paved track, 785 m; registration until 1 April 2026; personal assistant fee: 35 euros/day; vegetarian meals and medical assistance included.

name: 2. E.ON Business Run
description: The E.ON Business Run is a special running event held at the National Athletics Centre in Budapest. The race aims to bring together people from the corporate world and everyone interested in a shared active experience, where both individual achievement and team spirit take centre stage. Runners can choose from three options: a 5 km individual run, a 3-person relay (3 × 2.7 km), or a 2 km walking stadium tour. Music, a party and street food accompany the event, making it an unforgettable experience even after the run.
course_highlights: The iconic running track at the National Athletics Centre
Three distance options: 5 km individual run, 3 × 2.7 km relay, and a 2 km walking stadium tour
Run near the Danube, enjoy the stadium experience and soak up the fantastic party atmosphere
additional: Payment at the event is possible by bank card and SZÉP card. Registration requires a BSI account. Finishers receive a unique finisher’s medal. After the race, participants can enjoy a fantastic party, music and street food. Each runner in the 3-person relay completes approximately 2.7 km. Free online training and a charity option are also available at the event. Distances: 5 km, 3-person relay (3 × 2.7 km), stadium tour (2 km walking). The event takes place at the National Athletics Centre in Budapest. Participation is possible with online or on-site registration.

name: E.ON BUSINESS RUN
description: The E.ON Business Run is a special running event taking place on May 6, 2026, at the National Athletics Centre in Budapest. The event welcomes not only people from the corporate world but everyone interested in coming together to get active, take on a challenge and celebrate. There are three distances: an individual 5 km, a 3-person relay (3 × 2.7 km) and a 2 km stadium walking tour. Participants will receive a unique finisher’s medal, and music, street food and an evening party will provide the entertainment.
course_highlights: The iconic track at the National Athletics Centre
3 distances: individual 5 km, 3 × 2.7 km relay, 2 km stadium walking tour
A special riverside location on the Danube
additional: Online registration is available only by bank card and SZÉP card. A BSI account is required to register. Finishers receive a unique finisher’s medal. Music, street food and an evening party await participants. Contact details for the registration office are available on the website. Music, street food and a festive atmosphere await participants at the National Athletics Centre, where community activities will also take place alongside the running event.

name: РЕКОРД НА ХАЙДУШКАТА ПЪТЕКА 2026
description: Haydushka Path Record 2026 is an annual race held in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven. Participants compete to climb the iconic path from its starting point to the large fountain next to the Karandila Hotel. The route offers several variations of differing difficulty. The race is for prestige, with no categories or prize fund; results are officially recorded and published for every participant who climbs the path in under 1 hour. This is a unique challenge for lovers of mountain running and nature.
course_highlights: Climb the iconic Haydushka Path in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park
Route with several variations—the shortest is the steepest and most difficult
Finish at the large fountain next to the Karandila Hotel
additional: The race has no categories, age restrictions, or prize fund. Only the time from start to finish is measured. The record holder’s name is added to a special sign at the start of the path. Results for participants with a time under 1 hour are published on the website of the Old Elm Foundation. The event features trail running on different routes and has no categories or prizes, with an emphasis on personal achievements and records.

name: ЮНАШКИ ИГРИ 2026
description: Yunashki Games 2026 takes place in Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven on May 6, in honour of Haji Dimitar’s birthday and St. George’s Day—the Day of Bravery. The event celebrates the traditions and spirit of the hajduks, featuring games and competitions in which they tested their strength when choosing a vojvoda. The course and atmosphere are connected to the region’s historical heritage and the natural beauty of Sinite Kamani. It is organized by the Old Elm Foundation, which works to preserve Sliven’s cultural heritage and nature.
course_highlights: Held in Sinite Kamani Nature Park, with alpine-type terrain
The course follows ancient hajduk trails and passes near 14 ancient and medieval fortresses
An area with numerous rocky peaks, steep slopes, caves and waterfalls
additional: The event is part of the Old Elm Foundation’s traditional patriotic initiatives and is held in honour of historical figures and events connected with the hajduks and Bulgarian history. Registration and briefing take place at the Sinite Kamani Nature Park Information Centre; competitions include stone and knife throwing. Participants are encouraged to wear traditional folk costumes.

name: Crosul de noapte
description: Crosul de Noapte - Delonghi este o cursă de alergare organizată în Cluj-Napoca, care oferă participanților două distanțe: 4 km și 10 km. Evenimentul se desfășoară pe 8 mai 2026 și este potrivit pentru alergători de toate nivelurile care doresc să se bucure de o experiență sportivă nocturnă în oraș. Este o oportunitate excelentă de a alerga într-un cadru urban, într-o atmosferă prietenoasă și competitivă.
course_highlights: Distanțe de 4 km și 10 km
Alergare nocturnă în Cluj-Napoca
Traseu urban accesibil pentru toate nivelurile
additional: Evenimentul include trasee bine marcate, posibilitate de înscriere online și un mediu sigur pentru participanți.

name: Columbia Sunset Trail
description: The Columbia Sunset Trail is an exciting trail-running race held at sunset in the area around Naszály Hill. Runners receive a unique wooden finisher’s medal, and the top three women and men in each distance receive special prizes. The event offers plenty of aid stations, changing rooms and luggage storage. Runners are advised to use a headlamp and hydration pack. The atmosphere and proximity to nature are sure to make this an unforgettable experience.
course_highlights: Run at sunset in the area around Naszály Hill
Unique wooden finisher’s medal for every distance
Plenty of refreshments at the aid stations and finish
additional: Free, cool photos available the day after the race. Changing rooms and luggage storage at the base. A working, fully charged headlamp is mandatory. Your mobile phone must be charged, switched on and have the volume turned up. You must use a hydration pack, bottle or cup, as there will be no disposable cups at the aid stations or finish. This trail-running event welcomes runners with excellent organization and participant services, including photos, prizes and equipment recommendations.

name: COLUMBIA SUNSET TRAIL
location: Naszály, Bocskai utca 1, Naszály, Pest County, Hungary
description: The Columbia Sunset Trail is an exciting trail-running race held at sunset in the scenic surroundings of Naszály. Runners receive a unique wooden finisher’s medal at every distance, and the top finishers are awarded special medals. The event offers plenty of aid stations, changing rooms and baggage storage. For a safe race, runners are advised to use a headlamp and a hydration pack. The atmosphere and closeness to nature are sure to make this an unforgettable experience.
course_highlights: Run at sunset in Naszály’s natural surroundings
Unique wooden finisher’s medal at every distance
Plenty of refreshments at the aid stations and finish
additional: Free, fantastic photos available the day after the race. Special medals for the first three female and male finishers at each distance. Changing rooms and baggage storage at the base. A headlamp is mandatory; it must be in working order and fully charged. Bring a fully charged, switched-on, working mobile phone with the volume turned up. A hydration pack, bottle or cup is recommended, as there will be no disposable cups at the aid stations or finish. An ID card or a legible copy is required for registration. This trail-running event offers participants plenty of refreshments, safety equipment and memorable experiences.

name: Iron Ultra Trail
description: Iron Ultra Trail is a challenging trail race held in Valjevo, known for its demanding courses and beautiful landscapes of Western Serbia. The race brings together trail-running enthusiasts and adventurous spirits, offering a unique experience across forest and mountain terrain. The organizers, West Serbia Trails, promise a great atmosphere and smooth organization for all participants.
course_highlights: Courses through the forests and mountains of Western Serbia
Challenging climbs and technical sections of the course
Beautiful natural landscapes and unspoiled nature
additional: The organizer is West Serbia Trails, known for putting on the best trail parties in Western Serbia.

description: Bucharest International Half Marathon by Constantina Diță este o cursă internațională de semimaraton ce se desfășoară pe cele mai frumoase și rapide străzi din București, oferind oportunitatea unui record personal competitiv atât pentru atleții profesioniști, cât și pentru alergătorii amatori. Evenimentul include și curse de 10 km, curse pentru persoane cu dizabilități locomotorii și o cursă populară de 3,5 km pentru toate vârstele. Kitul de participare conține număr de concurs cu chip timing și medalie pentru finishers, iar tricoul oficial este opțional. Organizatorul este Asociația Club Sportiv Constantina Diță, iar evenimentul este susținut de parteneri importanți precum Decathlon.
course_highlights: Traseu plat și rapid pe străzile principale ale Bucureștiului
Cursă certificată World Athletics Label pentru semimaraton
Trasee dedicate pentru semimaraton, 10 km, persoane cu dizabilități și cursă populară
additional: Kit-ul de participare se ridică exclusiv în persoană la Expo pe baza actului de identitate. Tricoul oficial este opțional și se poate achiziționa separat la prețul de 15 EUR. Participarea persoanelor în fotolii rulante este gratuită. Timpul maxim pentru semimaraton este de 3 ore, iar pentru cursa de 10 km este de 1.5 ore. Unele străzi vor fi închise pe durata evenimentului, recomandându-se folosirea transportului în comun, în special metroul până la stația Aviatorilor. Traseul include opțiuni pentru alergare și mers, cu posibilitatea de a participa la recorduri; evenimentul include și alte curse precum 10 km și ștafete.

description: Subcarpați Trail Run este o competiție de alergare montană organizată pentru pasionații de trail running, care oferă o experiență unică în inima pădurii Goruna, în Subcarpații prahoveni. Traseele variate, de la Fun Race până la Ultramaraton, pun la încercare rezistența și perseverența alergătorilor, într-un cadru natural spectaculos. Evenimentul adună atât amatori, cât și profesioniști, într-o atmosferă prietenoasă și motivantă, cu start și sosire la Baza Sportivă „Stejarul” din Cocorăștii Mislii. Este o ocazie excelentă de a descoperi frumusețea zonei și de a trăi bucuria alergării în natură.
course_highlights: Trasee în pădurea Goruna, cu peisaje de coline împădurite
Dificultăți variate, de la 4 km Fun Race la 75 km Ultramaraton cu 2800 m diferență de nivel
Start și sosire la Baza Sportivă „Stejarul” Cocorăștii Mislii
additional: Ridicarea kiturilor se face vineri 16:30-21:30 și sâmbătă dimineața în funcție de cursă. Startul Ultramaratonului este la 06:00, Maratonul la 10:00, iar Semimaratonul și Crosul tot la 10:00. Fun Race începe după ora 11:45. Premii în bani și produse sunt oferite câștigătorilor, inclusiv bonus pentru recorduri de cursă. Trasee variate, start și sosire la Baza Sportivă „Stejarul”, posibilitate de înscriere la fața locului, fotografi oficiali pe traseu

description: Thermal Trail Race este o competiție de trail running ce se desfășoară în Betfia / Băile 1 Mai, pe potecile pitorești ale pădurii din zonă. Evenimentul oferă două probe, una de 14 km și una de 7 km, potrivite pentru diferite categorii de vârstă și niveluri de experiență. Traseele sunt bine marcate și oferă o experiență sportivă în natură, cu premii pentru cei mai buni concurenți. Participanții beneficiază de cronometrare electronică și tricou oficial al evenimentului.
course_highlights: Traseul se întinde pe potecile pădurii Băile 1 Mai, cu marcaje clare și indicatoare
Startul și sosirea sunt în zona Avenul Betfia (parcare)
Cronometrare cu cip electronic integrat în numărul de concurs
additional: Premiere pentru primii trei clasați la categoria OPEN și pe categorii de vârstă. Cronometrare cu cip electronic lipit pe spatele numărului de concurs. Transferul înscrierii către altă persoană este permis până pe 20 Mai 2026, cu o taxă de 25 lei. Taxa de participare se restituie până pe 10 Mai 2026, cu o reținere de 25 lei. Tricou oficial al evenimentului inclus. Traseele de trail running se desfășoară în zona Betfia / Baile 1 Mai, cu taxe de înscriere în lei, în funcție de cursul BNR. Data evenimentului este stabilită pentru 9 mai 2026, iar înscrierile sunt deschise pentru participanți din întreaga țară și nu numai.

name: TRAILRUN IN TARA NASAUDULUI
location: Casuțele din Plai, Valea Caselor, Năsăud, Bistrița-Năsăud, Romania
description: Trail Run în Țara Năsăudului este un eveniment de alergare în natură destinat tuturor categoriilor de vârstă și nivelurilor de experiență, desfășurat în jurul Casuțelor din Plai, Valea Caselor, Năsăud. Evenimentul oferă trei curse diferite: un traseu de 2 km pentru copii și familii, un traseu intermediar de 5 km cu urcări scurte și poteci de pădure, și un traseu de 10 km dedicat alergătorilor care caută o provocare autentică de trail running. Participanții se bucură de o atmosferă de susținere, socializare și fair-play, cu puncte de hidratare pe trasee și un Starter Kit inclus pentru cursele de 5 km și 10 km.
course_highlights: Traseu de 2 km pentru copii și familii, cu 1 punct de hidratare
Traseu de 5 km cu urcări scurte, poteci de pădure și priveliști asupra dealurilor din jurul orașului Năsăud
Traseu de 10 km cu 2 puncte de hidratare, dedicat alergătorilor care iubesc provocările autentice de trail running
additional: Startul și sosirea fiecărui traseu sunt la Casuțele din Plai, Valea Caselor, Năsăud. Accesul cu mașina la start este interzis; organizatorii asigură microbuze de la parcarea capelei orașului Năsăud (punctul de întâlnire și parcare). Traseele sunt disponibile pe Strava, cu posibilitatea de a descărca GPX-uri pentru smartwatch sau telefon. Starter Kit-ul include tricoul oficial și medalia pentru 10K, medalia pentru 5K, și diploma pentru 2K. Locul 1 la 10K Challenge primește și 2 nopți de cazare la Casuțele din Plai. Evenimentul include trasee pentru toate vârstele și nivelurile, cu accent pe natură, comunitate și fair-play, startul fiind în Valea Caselor, Năsăud.
