description: Trascău Trail Run este o cursă montană ce oferă trei probe: maraton, semimaraton și cros, desfășurate în peisaje pitorești din zona Rimetea, Alba. Traseele trec prin locuri spectaculoase precum Piatra Secuiului, Cetatea Colțești, Cheile Plaiului și Peștera Huda lui Papară, oferind o experiență de alergare montană cu diferențe semnificative de nivel și priveliști impresionante. Evenimentul este organizat de Asociația Green & Wild și pune accent pe aventura în natură și patrimoniul local. Participanții beneficiază de puncte de hidratare și alimentare, medalii și premii, iar înscrierile sunt limitate și se fac online.
course_highlights: Traseul maratonului include o urcare abruptă pe platoul Bedeleu și trece prin Rezervația Geologică Cheile Plaiului
Semimaratonul urcă pe Piatra Secuiului și traversează Creasta de Cocoș cu priveliști asupra Colților Trascăului
Crosul oferă o experiență montană accesibilă, cu peisaje liniștite în pădurea de lângă masivul Ardeșcheia
additional: Locuri limitate: 100 pentru maraton, 250 pentru semimaraton, 200 pentru cros. Kit-uri de concurs se predau în Cluj-Napoca și Rimetea. Ședințe tehnice înainte de start pentru fiecare probă. Medalii doar pentru cei care se încadrează în timpul limită. Participanții sunt înscriși automat la tombola de după premiere, prezența obligatorie la extragere. Trail race cu multiple categorii, teren montan pitoresc, repere culturale și naturale, înscrieri până în septembrie 2026, participare gratuită pentru persoanele cu dizabilități

name: FARKASMÁLYI DŰLŐ- ÉS PINCEFUTÁS
location: Gyöngyös Farkasmályi pincesor, Gyöngyös, Heves County, Hungary
organizer: Gyöngyösi Triatlon Klub, Farkasmályi Borpincék Egyesület
description: The Farkasmály Vineyard and Cellar Run is a unique running race along the cellar row in Farkasmály, Gyöngyös, taking place on May 2, 2026. Participants run through beautiful vineyards and wine cellars on varied terrain with some small hills. The race includes a shorter, less hilly loop and a longer loop with more elevation, so everyone can find a suitable distance. The event is organized by GYÖTRI Klub, one of the region’s leading sports clubs.
course_highlights: Vineyard Loop: 3000 m, 40 m elevation gain, 2 laps, through vineyards and wine cellars
Farkasmály Loop: 8500 m, 190 m elevation gain, 4 laps, hilly terrain and visits to cellars
Relay race and fröccs race for teams, with special wine-fröccs drinking stations
additional: Registration and race-bib pickup from 13:00; on-site registration closes 15 minutes before the start of the relevant event. Parking is available on the grassy area next to the Szilue Hotel. Race distances: Vineyard Loop (2 laps), Farkasmály Loop (4 laps), relay race 4x1500 m, and a fröccs race for teams of 3: 800 m + 4 fröccs drinking stations (wine or must fröccs). At the end of each lap, the course passes through cellars; runners climb a small hill towards the finish arch. Trail running, routes between cellars, wine tasting, advance and on-site registration, awards, open cellars, refreshments, and awards ceremony.

name: SzalamandRUN futónap 3 / 5 / 11 / 21 / 42
description: The SzalamandRUN running day is a race in Solymár offering a variety of distances: 3, 5, 11, 21 and 42 km. The event is ideal for both beginners and experienced runners who want to test themselves over different distances. The race takes place in a natural setting, providing participants with an enjoyable running experience. The organizers offer professional timing and convenient registration options.
course_highlights: A running course close to nature around Solymár
A variety of distances: 3, 5, 11, 21 and 42 km
Professional chip timing (RFID, HuTag)
additional: Chip timing (RFID, HuTag) is provided at the race. Registration takes place on korido.hu, where automatic confirmation and SimplePay card payment are also available. Race bibs and safety pins are provided to participants. The race is held across multiple categories and distances, with children’s races also available, and the organizers prioritize athletes’ experience.

name: Előzd meg a Fogaskerekűt!
description: Beat the Cogwheel! is a traditional sporting event in Budapest’s 12th district, welcoming runners, cyclists, and relay teams in 2026. The aim is to reach the finish before the Cogwheel Railway while tackling an approximately 4 km climb with 325 metres of elevation gain in the Buda Hills. The race challenges athletes of all fitness levels and is also a great group activity for families and colleagues. The event is organised by Hegyvidéki Szabadidősport Nonprofit Kft. and Városmajori Tanuszoda.
course_highlights: Approx. 4.0 km distance
325 metres of elevation gain
Scenic surroundings in the Buda Hills
additional: Participants can enter in running, cycling, and relay categories. Rules on wearing race numbers and using chips, along with the privacy notice and terms and conditions, are available among the official documents. Competitors can enter age groups for those under and over 18, and results from previous years can be viewed in the archive. The race is known as an extreme challenge and offers prizes, individual and relay options, and registration details on the official website.

name: Krones Charity Run
location: Déli Ipari Park, Debrecen, Hajdú-Bihar County, Hungary
description: The Krones Charity Run is a charity running event taking place on May 9, 2026, in Debrecen, on the grounds of the Southern Industrial Park. In addition to promoting sport and physical activity, the event aims to introduce the venue and support the Foundation for Children with Leukemia. The full amount of the entry fees, along with donations doubled by Krones Hungary, will be donated to the foundation. Participants can choose from several distances, and everyone who finishes receives a unique finisher’s medal. A MIZUNO event T-shirt and full BioTechUSA refreshments are provided, and the Athletes Garden will welcome runners at the end of the event.
course_highlights: 10 km individual race, on a 4-lap course
Held in the Southern Industrial Park, where Krones Hungary was the first company to move in
MIZUNO event T-shirt and BioTechUSA refreshments at the aid stations
additional: Registration takes place through the StafétApp mobile app, which is available free of charge. Race packs are also collected using StafétApp. Every runner who finishes within the time limit receives a unique finisher’s medal. The Athletes Garden will provide an on-site program at the end of the event. Eco-friendly, ÖKO race packs are used, and plastic use is reduced. The full amount of the entry fees will be donated to charity. Online and on-site registration are both available, and the participation package includes a MIZUNO T-shirt and BioTechUSA refreshments.

name: CSALÁDI FUTÓNAP
location: Bocskai István Általános Iskola, Páty, Pest County, Hungary
description: The EDURACE Family Trail Running Day is a family-friendly recreational trail-running event organized by the EDUSPORT Sports Association. The race takes place in Erzsébet Park in Gödöllő and offers races for all ages, from children’s races to a half marathon. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and a sense of community, with expert support and a varied program. Participants receive a finisher’s pack, a medal, and refreshments, and the day concludes with a colorful Color Run.
course_highlights: Trail-running course in Erzsébet Park, Gödöllő
No elevation gain; distances are easy to complete
Children’s races and team races for families
additional: Race-number pickup and on-site registration from 07:30; warm-up at 09:00; children’s races from 13:30; Color Run at 15:30. The entry fee includes timekeeping, a race number, a finisher’s medal, a finisher’s pack, and refreshments. Changing rooms, toilets, and bag storage are available at the event. Children’s races, team races, Color Run, prize draw, online and on-site registration, detailed routes, refreshment stations, commemorative medal, finisher’s pack

name: EDURACE
location: Erzsébet Park, Gödöllő, Pest County, Hungary
distance_verbose: Félmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The EDURACE Family Trail Running Day is a varied trail-running event taking place in 2026 in Erzsébet Park, Gödöllő. It offers several distances, from 500-meter children’s races to a half marathon, making it suitable for all ages and levels of running experience. Alongside nature-filled routes and a community atmosphere, participants can look forward to a unique finisher’s medal and a great time. The event aims to appeal to families and sports enthusiasts alike and promote a healthy, active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Forest routes with varied terrain in Erzsébet Park
Elevation differences ranging from 24 m to 340 m across the different distances
A unique finisher’s medal and family-friendly activities at the finish
additional: Race bib collection begins on October 31 at 16:00. Free cloakroom and bag storage are available. On-site registration is possible in limited numbers, but advance online registration is recommended. Medical staff will be available at the event; participation is at your own risk. The event features several distances, family and children’s races, team competitions, a pet-friendly race, online and on-site registration, and post-race activities.

name: FUT A VÁROS
location: Fő tér, Szombathely, Vas County, Hungary
description: The Szombathely Running Race, Fut a város, will take place on May 9, 2026, in the heart of the city, on Fő tér. The race offers several distances, so runners of all ages and abilities can find an option that suits them: a 400-metre children’s race, 2 km, 5 km, 10 km individual races, and a 4×2.5 km relay. The event promotes sport and a healthy lifestyle. Participants can look forward to unique finisher medals and chip timing. The race has a family-friendly atmosphere, with courses passing through the city’s historic sites, refreshment points and medical supervision.
course_highlights: Run past Szombathely’s historic sites, including Fő tér, the Fountain and Sportliget
Routes are secured and partially or fully closed to traffic throughout the race
Refreshment point at the finish and chip timing
additional: Chip timing will be used, and every participant will receive a unique finisher medal. Competitors under 14 must submit parental consent for distances over 2 km. Race packs can be collected at the venue from 7:30. The use of mobile phones and other audio devices with headphones during the race is prohibited. Chip timing will be used; race-pack collection is at the event centre, registration opens at 07:30, and start times vary by category.

name: ÚJPESTI FÉLMARATON
location: Halassy Olivér Sportközpont, Budapest IV. kerület, Budapest, Hungary
organizer: Budapest Főváros IV. ker. Újpest Önkormányzata
description: The Újpest Half Marathon is a popular running event taking place on May 9, 2026, at the Halassy Olivér Sports Center in Budapest’s 4th district. Runners can enter individually or as part of a relay, for the quarter-marathon or half-marathon distances. The event aims to promote sport and a sense of community in Újpest in a friendly, family-oriented atmosphere. Participants can choose a T-shirt size when registering, and the organizers ensure the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: The event takes place at the Halassy Olivér Sports Center, one of Budapest’s popular sports centers.
Distances include the 21 km half marathon and the 10.5 km quarter marathon, with a relay category also available.
The race features refreshment stations and chip timing, with medals awarded at the finish.
additional: Entries are available in individual and relay categories for the quarter-marathon and half-marathon distances. Participants can choose a T-shirt size when registering (XS–3XL). A maximum of 5 people can be entered at once in the individual category. Providing an emergency contact is mandatory. Registration is online only, and the entry fee includes a race pack, T-shirt, sports drinks, refreshments, a medal, and medical coverage. The course runs partly along a stream embankment and partly on asphalt.

name: SCHRÖDINGER DELUXE ULTRA
description: Schrödinger Deluxe Ultra 2026 is a trail running race near Piliscsaba, taking place on May 9, 2026. The race starts at Csemetekert at 8:00 a.m. Runners follow varied terrain, passing several notable locations and natural landmarks in the Pilis Mountains. The race offers a unique experience for those who enjoy nature and a challenge.
course_highlights: Varied terrain in the Pilis Mountains
Passing numerous natural landmarks and local points of interest, such as Sas-szikla, Fehér-hegy, and the Saint-Gobain lookout
Challenging elevation gains and forest sections
additional: The race starts at Csemetekert. The organizers can be reached at info@gulyakor.hu, +36 20 2992446. The race is part of the Gulyakör trail series, which includes multiple distances and events. Registration is via the website, but no specific prices are available in the sources. Trail relay race, 35 checkpoints, unknown order, approximately 143 km, registration deadlines and fees specified.

name: Zuglói-Patakparti Futás
distance_verbose: 100 miles, 120 km, 5 km, 2.2 km, 1 km, 0.3 km

name: Fox Trail Čardak 2026
description: Fox Trail Čardak is a race through the unique landscape of Deliblato Sands, giving participants the chance to choose from three distances: a 5 km recreational race, a challenging 12 km race, and a 21 km trail half marathon. The event takes place on May 9, 2026, in Čardak, and is intended for everyone who loves nature and running, whether beginner or experienced. The course is carefully designed to offer an authentic trail-running experience, with fitting challenges and the beauty of the sands.
course_highlights: The course winds through the unique landscape of Deliblato Sands
Three distances: 5 km, 12 km, and a 21 km trail half marathon
Aid stations with water, fruit, and other refreshments
additional: One aid station on the course will offer water, fruit, peanuts, and sugar. There are two drinking fountains along the course for additional hydration. Registration is open until April 22, 2026; the event is intended for trail-running and nature enthusiasts.

name: Международен турнир за юноши и девойки под 18 г. „Младост”
description: The “Mladost” International Tournament for boys and girls under 18 is held at the City Stadium in Ruse. This competition has a rich tradition and brings together young athletes from different countries to compete in a range of track and field events. The tournament focuses on developing youth sport and offers talented athletes under 18 an opportunity to compete. The organizers emphasize that registered performances are required for entry in some events, such as the girls’ long jump.
course_highlights: Competitions at the City Stadium in Ruse
International participation by boys and girls under 18
21 track and field events
additional: Registered performances are required to enter the girls’ under-18 long jump; competitors without them will not be admitted. The competition includes 21 events and more than 300 participants. Results and start lists are publicly available. The competition is open to young athletes under 18 and is part of their preparation for European championships and international competitions.

name: Трън Ултра Рън
description: Tran Ultra Run is an ultramarathon mountain-running race held in the picturesque Kraishte region, based in the village of Turokovtsi, Tran Municipality. The race offers four courses of varying distances and elevation gains, crossing the Rui, Ezimir and Greben mountains, with numerous panoramic views and varied terrain ranging from soft trails to rocky sections. Organized by the Tran Tourist Association with the support of Tran Municipality, the event is suitable for mountain-running enthusiasts seeking a challenge and beautiful scenery.
course_highlights: The routes pass the peaks of Mali Rui, Orlovets and Rakitski Kamik, and the Erma River Gorge
Varied terrain: soft trails, rocky sections, steep slopes and panoramic views
additional: All courses are circular, starting and finishing in the village of Turokovtsi. There are aid stations with water and food along the courses, but cups are not provided. Every participant is covered by mandatory insurance. Medical staff and an ambulance are available at the start/finish. Use of GPS tracks in .gpx format is recommended. The courses are circular, with aid stations and medical assistance; participants must carry mandatory equipment and use GPS tracks. The race is part of a series of courses and is certified by ITRA.

name: Alpinist TRI
description: The Climbing Triathlon “New Life for Alpinist Hut” is a unique competition that replaces classic swimming with a vertical challenge. It takes place around Alpinist Hut and the village of Basarbovo, Ruse, and consists of three disciplines: MTB cycling, running, and a final ascent via a via ferrata. The competition can be entered individually or as a two-person relay, and all proceeds go toward restoring the hut. It’s a chance to test yourself against nature and support a worthy cause in one of the most beautiful areas of the Polomie region.
course_highlights: MTB cycling: 21 km with +350 m elevation gain
Running: 10 km with +220 m elevation gain
Final ascent via the newest via ferrata in Northern Bulgaria
additional: The start is in front of Alpinist Hut, Basarbovo village. Relay teams consist of two people, and the entry fee is for the whole team. Relay categories are men’s, women’s, and mixed. The event supports the restoration of Alpinist Hut. Courses: MTB 21 km, running 10 km, via ferrata; categories: individual and relay; location: Alpinist Hut, Basarbovo; date: May 9, 2026.

name: Amusnet Charity Run 2026
description: Amusnet Charity Run 2026 is a trail run with a cause, held near the village of Zheleznitsa, close to Sofia. The course is just over 5 km and offers varied terrain, including a beautiful forest trail, a challenging climb and a final descent. The event is open to everyone, whether you want to run or walk. The main goal is to take part and support the National Paralympic Federation. For every kilometre completed, Amusnet donates €5 to support Bulgarian athletes with disabilities.
course_highlights: 0–3 km: Flat and beautiful forest trail
3–4 km: A demanding climb of around 1 km
4–5+ km: Descent and a final sprint to the finish
additional: Professional timing, with results published after the event. Parking near the start is limited; participants are advised to use the large car park at the edge of the village, around 2 km from the start/finish area. Participation is free. The course is just over 5 km with varied terrain; support for Paralympians; registration via the form; limited parking capacity; prizes for participants and staff.

name: Tran Ultra Run
description: Trun Ultra Run is a mountain race held in the scenic Kraishte region, with the village of Turokovtsi, Trun Municipality, as its hub. The race offers four courses of varying lengths and elevation gains, crossing the Ruй, Ezimirska, and Greben mountains, with numerous peaks and panoramic views. The courses are loop routes with varied terrain, including soft trails, rocky sections, steep slopes, and forested areas. Organized by the Trun Tourist Association with the support of Trun Municipality, the race provides course markings, aid stations, and medical assistance for participants.
course_highlights: Four loop courses of 14 km, 23 km, 43 km, and 64 km, with elevation gains from 700 to 3,300 meters
Routes through the Rui, Ezimirska, and Greben mountains, with numerous peaks and panoramic views
Varied terrain with soft trails, rocky sections, steep slopes, and forested areas
additional: All courses are loop routes starting and finishing in the village of Turokovtsi. Aid stations along the courses provide water and food, but cups are not provided. Mandatory insurance is taken out for every participant. Medical personnel and an ambulance are available at the start/finish. Use of GPS tracks in .gpx format is recommended. Multiple courses of different lengths, with routes through scenic Bulgaria, are awaiting ITRA certification.

name: Wings for Life World App Run : Oradea
description: Wings for Life World Run este o cursă globală unică pentru alergători și participanți în scaun cu rotile, unde nu există o linie de sosire fixă. Participanții aleargă pentru a rămâne înaintea Mașinii Virtuale de Capturare, care pornește la 30 de minute după start și crește treptat viteza până când toți sunt prinși. Evenimentul din Oradea, România, pe 10 mai 2026, se desfășoară pe un circuit asfaltat de 1,7 km în inima fabricii Nokian Tyres. Toate taxele de înscriere și donațiile merg integral către cercetarea leziunilor măduvei spinării.
course_highlights: Circuit asfaltat de 1,7 km în interiorul fabricii Nokian Tyres
Participare deschisă alergătorilor și utilizatorilor de scaune cu rotile
Mașina Virtuală de Capturare pornește la 30 de minute după start și crește viteza progresiv
additional: Eveniment accesibil pentru participanții în scaun cu rotile. Startul este simultan la nivel mondial, iar Mașina Virtuală de Capturare începe urmărirea la 30 de minute după start cu o viteză inițială de 14 km/h, crescând progresiv. 100% din taxele de înscriere și donații sunt direcționate către proiecte de cercetare a leziunilor măduvei spinării. Evenimentul suportă participarea pe oricât distanță, fără o linie de sosire fixă, și include înscrierea prin aplicație. Participanții pot alerga individual sau în grup, iar toate fondurile strânse sunt direcționate către cercetarea leziunilor medulare.

name: VW Mureș Half Marathon
description: VW Mureș Half Marathon 2026 te invită să alergi în inima Transilvaniei, prin centrul orașului Târgu Mureș, pe 10 mai 2026. Evenimentul oferă trasee variate de 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, ștafetă 4x5 km și cursă pentru copii, toate cu startul și sosirea în zona centrală, ideală pentru susținerea de către familie și prieteni. Participanții vor descoperi punctele turistice reprezentative ale orașului într-o atmosferă vibrantă de primăvară, bucurându-se de premii, medalii și energie bună la fiecare pas. Organizatorul este Asociația Mureș Runners, care promovează un stil de viață sănătos și comunitatea prin sport.
course_highlights: Trasee prin centrul orașului Târgu Mureș, cu puncte turistice reprezentative
Start și sosire în Piața Teatrului, zona centrală a orașului
Varietate de probe: semimaraton 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, ștafetă 4x5 km și cursă copii
additional: Pachetul de înscriere include tricou oficial, număr de concurs, cip de cronometrare, medalie de finisher, broșuri sponsori, diplome online, fotografii oficiale și acces la punctele de hidratare și alimentare. Echipamentul obligatoriu la start este pantofi de alergare, echipament sportiv și număr de concurs vizibil. Evenimentul promovează protecția mediului, fiind interzisă aruncarea deșeurilor în afara locurilor amenajate. Participanții pot alege între mai multe distanțe, inclusiv semimaraton, ștafetă și cursa pentru copii; evenimentul promovează activitatea fizică și turismul local în Târgu Mureș.

name: Budureasa Mountain Running
description: Budureasa Mountain Running este un concurs de alergare montană organizat de ACS Bihorul Oradea în parteneriat cu Primăria Budureasa și Consiliul Local. Evenimentul include două probe principale: Eco Cros 8 km și Cros 16 km, dedicate alergătorilor de anduranță cu vârsta minimă de 14 ani. Traseele pornesc și se termină în fața Căminului Cultural Budureasa, oferind o experiență montană cu urcări și coborâri pe drumuri de piatră, trail și șosea. Pe traseu sunt amplasate puncte de revitalizare cu apă, băuturi izotonice și fructe. Participarea este deschisă tuturor alergătorilor apți, cu condiții speciale pentru minorii sub 18 ani.
course_highlights: Traseu comun Eco Cros 8 km și Cros 16 km până la km 4,5 cu punct de revitalizare
Urcări abrupte și diferențe de nivel semnificative, inclusiv o urcare de 450 m cu 170 m diferență pozitivă
Ultimii kilometri pe șosea, cu puncte de hidratare și coborâri line
additional: Confirmarea participării se face sâmbătă între 16:00 - 20:00 sau în ziua concursului între 8:00 - 10:30 la Căminul Cultural Budureasa. Ședință tehnică sâmbătă 09.05.2026 între 19:00 - 19:30 și în ziua concursului la 10:00. Pe traseu sunt 3 puncte de revitalizare pentru Cros 16 km și 1 punct pentru Eco Cros 8 km cu apă, băuturi izotonice și fructe. Înscrierile se validează doar după plata taxei, iar modificările sau anulările se pot face doar în scris până la 26.04.2026. Sportivii suspendați pentru dopaj nu au drept de participare. Traseul poate suferi modificări din cauza condițiilor meteo; înscriere online până la 3 mai 2026, posibil și la fața locului; restricții pentru minori; reguli anti-doping.

name: Pusztafutás 1 / 5 / 11
description: Pusztafutás is a friendly, family-oriented trail running race held every year since 2016 in Solt Szőlőhegy. It offers several distances for runners of all ages, on a varied and exciting route that takes in hilly, interesting terrain rather than the familiar flat plains. Finishers receive a unique, interlocking finisher’s medal, and several facilities are available on site, including parking, a buffet and a playhouse. The race aims to provide an enjoyable experience for all ages and to offer runners a full event experience.
course_highlights: Varied, exciting terrain on the western edge of the Kiskunság
A marked 580-metre route with minimal elevation change
Start area at Szőlőhegy, next to Krammer Winery
additional: The race will be held only if at least 100 valid entries are received by the end of the first registration period. Entries are accepted from a maximum of 400 runners, including no more than 100 preschool and lower-primary-school-age children. Accompanying parents may not physically assist their child while running and do not need to register separately. The race offers unique, interlocking finisher’s medals, but runners can also register at a lower price without a medal. Parking, toilets, a playhouse, a first-aid point and a buffet are available on site. The race will not be held in 2026 because the number of entries did not reach the minimum set by the organizers.

description: The Garmin WTF BRZSNY is a unique trail-running race around Szokolya and Királyrét, taking place on May 10, 2026. It offers challenges over several distances, from 8 km up to the 42 km trail marathon, with varied elevation gain and beautiful woodland scenery. One special feature of the race is that road and trail runners start together, so everyone can complete the distance on their preferred terrain. The entry fee includes a race bib, timing, aid stations, baggage storage, changing facilities and medical services, as well as chimney cake at the finish and a choice of medals. The race prioritizes sustainability and a sense of community, where every achievement matters.
course_highlights: Trail distances of 8, 13, 23, 33 and 42 km, with varied elevation gain (from 230 m to 2,000 m)
A 10 km road race with 220 m of elevation gain
Beautiful woodland scenery around Szokolya and Királyrét
additional: The entry fee includes a race bib, timing, aid stations, free event photos, a route guide, baggage storage, changing facilities, medical services, a route permit and insurance. Runners can enjoy chimney cake at the finish and choose from six medals if they register in time. From 21 days after registration, entries can only be transferred and cannot be cancelled. Entries that include a T-shirt are not available after April 25. Participants receive medals, certificates, photos and insurance; a race bib and refreshments are also provided.

description: The 9th Runbogárd Running Race and Family Running Day will take place on May 10, 2026, in Sárbogárd, at the City Sports Hall. Runners can choose from the 1 km Smile Run and distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 20 km. All participants start together in a mass start. The event aims to promote a love of sport and create a community gathering where people of all ages can find a distance that suits them. Race numbers must be collected in advance; there is no on-site registration. Timing is chip-based, using a chip attached to the back of the race number.
course_highlights: The start and finish are at the same location, in the area in front of the City Sports Hall.
The Smile Run follows a marked 1 km course. The other distances run on paved roads, with traffic marshals assisting participants on busier sections.
Participants are asked to be especially alert on the course and to obey traffic rules.
additional: Race number collection is available on Saturday from 17:00 to 20:00 and on Sunday from 07:30 to 09:30. There is no on-site registration. Timing is provided by a chip attached to the back of the race number; it must not be removed or damaged. Race numbers are different colors for each event, making them easy to distinguish. Chip checking will be available on the morning of the race. The race is a mass start, with participants setting off together regardless of age or gender. Participants can enter several distances, with registration taking place online. Race day is May 10, 2026, and registration is open from 07:30 to 09:30. The course runs on city streets and designated running tracks, with chip timing. The family running day and the different award categories add to the event's appeal.

name: Fertőrákos félmaraton 6 / 16 / 21
location: Kőfejtő - Barlangszínház, Fertőrákos, Győr-Moson-Sopron County, Hungary
description: The Fertőrákos Half Marathon is a special scenic run above Lake Fertő, starting and finishing at the Quarry – Cave Theatre. The varied, gently undulating course takes runners through some of the area’s most beautiful spots. The longer distance reaches as far as Balf, with views of scenic Lake Fertő and its reed beds accompanying runners along the way. This race is not only a challenge but also an enjoyable running experience, with new views and inspiration at every kilometre. The event also operates as a green race, highlighting the importance of environmental protection.
course_highlights: Start and finish area at the Quarry – Cave Theatre
A varied, gently undulating course through some of the area’s most beautiful spots
Panoramic views of scenic Lake Fertő and its reed beds on the longer distance
additional: The race operates as a green race, highlighting the importance of environmental protection. Prizes are awarded to the top three women and men in the overall individual standings in each distance. Prizes are presented only at the awards ceremony; collection or postage at a later date is not available. The race is part of a points-collection system in which runners can earn points for every kilometre they run and redeem them for discounts at the end of the season. Race categories, course description, information about the environmentally friendly race, detailed rules and registration information are available on the website.

name: VIII. Szeged Maraton
location: Dóm tér, Szeged, Csongrád County, Hungary
distance_verbose: Maraton, 31 km, Félmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter
organizer: Szeged és Térsége Turisztikai Nonprofit Kft. Tourinform Szeged
description: The 8th Szeged Marathon is an annual running event in Szeged. It starts and finishes at the city’s iconic Dóm Square. Participants can choose from several distances, from the classic marathon (42.195 km) to shorter recreational distances (3 km). The race takes place on a 10.5 km loop course that runners complete multiple times. The route passes through central Szeged, allowing runners to enjoy the city’s landmarks. The event is family-friendly, with children’s races and a charity walk.
course_highlights: 10.5 km loop course through central Szeged
Start and finish at Dóm Square
The course passes the city’s landmarks
additional: The event offers several distances: marathon (42.195 km), 31.5 km, half marathon (21.1 km), 10.5 km, 3 km, as well as children’s races and a charity walk. The race takes place on Sunday, May 10, 2026, and the program runs from 08:30 to 18:30. Entries are made online by purchasing tickets at progrun.hu. Map, online registration, multiple distances, city course, charity option

name: EU-S FUTÁS 2026
organizer: Európai Bizottság Magyarországi Képviselete, Európai Parlament Magyarországi Kapcsolattartó Iroda, Nagy Sportágválasztó, BBU Nonprofit Kft.
description: The EU Half Marathon is a free running race requiring registration, taking place on May 10, 2026, at Szabadság tér in Budapest. Participants can run 21.1 kilometres individually or as part of a 2–3-person relay. The race is part of Budapest’s Europe Day festival. Runners follow a three-lap course passing iconic Budapest landmarks, and everyone who finishes receives a unique commemorative medal. The event is organised by the Representation of the European Commission in Hungary and the European Parliament Liaison Office in Hungary, with Nagy Sportágválasztó, BBU Nonprofit Kft. as professional partner.
course_highlights: The distance consists of three laps and can be completed individually or as part of a relay.
The route passes through central Budapest, including Szabadság tér, Nádor utca, Széchenyi rakpart and Margaret Bridge.
Refreshment stations along the course and chip-based net timekeeping.
additional: Race bibs, T-shirts and relay batons can be collected from May 5–8, between 11:00 and 19:00, at the Europa Experience Centre (1052 Budapest, Szervita tér 8.), and on May 10, between 7:00 and 8:30, at Szabadság tér. The relay zone is located between Nádor utca, Zoltán utca and Steindl Imre utca. The race uses chip timing; the final member of each relay team must hand in the baton at the finish. Participation is free but requires registration, and places are limited (2,000 individual runners and 700 relay teams). There will be no full road closures; traffic will be managed by the police and civil guard. Participants must register to take part. Race bibs and T-shirts can be collected from May 5–8 at Europa Experience, or at Szabadság tér on race day. The detailed course route, refreshment stations and start/finish locations can be found on the official website.

description: The Fussuk le! Half Marathon Festival is a three-day running event in Csongrád, taking place from May 8 to 10, 2026. The festival offers concerts, community activities and races, including half-marathon and quarter-marathon distances, as well as children’s races. The course is flat and paved, making it ideal for runners of all levels who want to compete in a fun, supportive community. The event aims to provide an unforgettable experience where you can run and cross the finish line with a smile.
course_highlights: The course is as flat as a pancake
99% paved route
Community activities and a concert on race weekend
additional: The festival begins with a concert on Friday, community activities take place on Saturday, and race day is Sunday. The entry fee includes refreshments on race day. For early-bird registration, payment is due within 7 days of registering; otherwise, the registration will be cancelled. Members of sports clubs receive a 50% discount on early-bird registration. Community training sessions, training plans, expert content, membership discounts, multiple distances, family and relay categories

name: UBM RED RUN FUTÓVERSENY
location: Kacsa tó, Pilisvörösvár, Pest County, Hungary
description: The UBM RedRun running race will take place on May 10, 2026, in the heart of Pilisvörösvár, around Kacsa Lake. For its fifth anniversary, the event welcomes runners who can choose distances from 300 meters to 21 km, individually or as part of a team. With new courses, expanded distances, and unique races, it offers an enjoyable experience for all ages, with a particular focus on families and amateur athletes. The event aims to create a shared sporting experience in a safe and friendly environment, in some of the most beautiful parts of Pilisvörösvár.
course_highlights: New courses through the heart of the town and some of the most beautiful parts of Pilisvörösvár
A 300-meter Ovi Run for the youngest participants, with or without an accompanying adult
A new 3.5 km distance that is fast and easy to complete, ideal for beginners
additional: There will be no relay race at the 2026 event, and the 7 km distance consists of one lap. The awards ceremony will take place at 12:00. Race bibs can be collected at the event center, beside the event tent at Kacsa Lake. Accepting the participation declaration is required to register. Participants will receive a medal, photos, and refreshments. The event will also feature children's races and an after-race party, with activities at Kacsa Lake and in the town center.

description: The Urbana Desetka Sports Association invites you to take part in the Urbana Half Marathon in Smederevo on May 10, 2026. The event features the second edition of the 21 km half marathon and the third edition of the Dunavska Desetka 10 km race. The routes run along the Danube, through the city center, past Villa Obrenović and through the Jugovo neighborhood. Runners will enjoy a mix of flat terrain and rolling vineyards, with the start at Republic Square in front of the courthouse. Every participant receives a race number with a timing chip, a unique T-shirt and a medal, as well as refreshments during and after the race.
course_highlights: The route follows the Danube and passes through central Smederevo
Passes Villa Obrenović and the Jugovo neighborhood
A mix of flat terrain and rolling vineyards
additional: The start area is Republic Square in front of the courthouse. Every participant receives a race number with a timing chip, a distinctive-quality T-shirt, refreshments during the race and after the finish, and a medal. Categories are overall men and women, juniors up to 18 years old, and veterans aged 46+ for both distances. Details about the terrain, registration and exact schedule are not available, but the event is expected to be well organized with support from local authorities.

name: First Challenge Run
description: First Challenge Run is a charity race taking place on May 10, 2026, at Ada Ciganlija in Belgrade. Runners will complete a 7.7 km loop around the lake, enjoying nature and a sporting challenge. The race is an opportunity to come together, socialize, and support a charitable cause, and is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners.
course_highlights: A loop around the lake at Ada Ciganlija
7.7 km course
Natural surroundings and a sporting challenge
additional: The race is charitable and intended for all ages and levels of running experience. Registration and participation details are not specified, but the event is intended for a broad audience and supports a good cause.

name: Ugrin run
description: Ugrin Run is a race held in Ugrinovci on May 10, 2026, starting at 10:00. The race offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, on a highly accessible, safe, and clearly marked course with two water and fruit stations. In addition to the main races, fun children’s races are organized for different age groups. They are free of charge with parental consent. Participants receive a unique medal at the finish, while merchandise prizes and trophies are provided for the top finishers.
course_highlights: The course is highly accessible, safe, and clearly marked
Two water and fruit stations along the course
Fun children’s races for preschool and elementary school children
additional: Race packs can be collected on race day from 07:00 to 09:30 at Stanko Marić Elementary School, Učitelja Cveje Street 5, near the start. Changing rooms and a baggage drop are available at the race-pack collection venue. Medical support is provided along the course and at the finish. Overall categories for men and women in both distances, with prizes for the best and fastest male and female runners from Ugrinovci. Ugrin Run 2026 is scheduled for May 10, 2026, with details about the organization, timekeeping, T-shirts, and medals. Participants can expect a well-organized event with support for runners of all categories.

name: Kozomor 2026
description: The Kozomor Mountaineering and Running Association and the PSS Mountaineering Trekking Commission invite competitors to the second round of the Serbian Trekking and Trail League, taking place on May 10, 2026, in Kosjerić. The race brings together enthusiasts of mountain trekking and trail running, offering a challenging and scenic course through nature. Participants can expect a well-organized event supported by experienced mountaineering and running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Trails through the mountain landscapes of Kosjerić
Challenging terrain for trekking and trail running
Organized as part of the Serbian Trekking League
additional: Participation includes mountaineering and trail activities, and the event is intended for lovers of nature and sport.

name: Elenovo Trail Run 2026
location: село Еленово, местност "Кара дере", община Нова Загора, област Сливен, Bulgaria
organizer: Народно читалище "Светлина-1908" и Община Нова Загора

description: Elenovo Trail Run is a new trail-running event in Nova Zagora Municipality, Sliven Province. The race takes place in the scenic Kara Dere area near the village of Elenovo, with varied courses suitable for runners of different levels. The event is part of the regional folklore festival and offers a unique opportunity to combine sport and nature with local traditions. The organizers provide GPX files for the courses to help participants prepare.
course_highlights: Courses of 4 km, 10/11 km, and 20/21 km on mountainous terrain
The Kara Dere area, with scenic views and natural beauty
Held as part of a folklore festival with a rich cultural program
additional: GPX files for the courses are available to download and use for preparation. The event takes place in an area with the Kara Dere reservoir. The organizer is the Nova Zagora Tourist Information Center, with coordinator Daniel Yordanov. The courses are available as downloadable GPX files; the event includes various routes and cultural activities in the Kara Dere area.

name: Sunrise Ultra
description: Sunrise Ultra is a challenging run across the rugged cliffs of Bulgaria’s northern coast, offering three distances: 42 km, 17 km, and 7 km. The race passes iconic natural and cultural landmarks in the municipalities of Kavarna and Shabla, combining endurance with the beauty of the seascape. Participants receive a special T-shirt and medal inspired by the sunrise and the vast sea, symbolizing the spirit of the event. It is a unique experience for nature lovers and runners seeking adventure and inspiration.
course_highlights: 42 km of rugged coastal beauty with an endless horizon
17 km along breathtaking cliffs with a sea breeze
7 fast and impressive kilometres along the coast
additional: Race packs are collected in the cities of Varna and Shabla, with a signed participation declaration. To collect a race pack for another participant, their signed declaration is required. Participants under 18 need a parental consent declaration. The medal symbolizes the sunrise, the waves, and the journey, while the T-shirt is an artistic interpretation of the event. After the race, participants can celebrate with wine from partner Villa Daros. The event features races over different distances, is supported by local authorities, and offers a unique opportunity to run amid the natural scenery of the Black Sea coast.

name: Wings for Life
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race for runners and wheelchair participants, taking place on May 10, 2026, in Borisova Gradina, Sofia. Instead of a traditional finish line, participants run until they are caught by the virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the race begins and gradually increases its speed. The event raises funds for spinal cord research, with 100% of entry fees and donations going to the cause. Participants can gather at the popular spot “Slancheto” in Borisova Gradina and take part using the Wings for Life World Run mobile app.
course_highlights: Start at the popular “Slancheto” area in Borisova Gradina
1.8 km of paved park paths
1.2 km of dirt-and-gravel path, followed by 1.8 km of wide paved road
additional: The race is accessible to wheelchair participants. The virtual Catcher Car begins chasing participants 30 minutes after the start at a speed of 14 km/h, which gradually increases. 100% of entry fees and donations go toward spinal cord research. Participants must use the Wings for Life World Run mobile app to take part and track their progress. Participants can join via the app or in person. The event is focused on charity and supporting scientific research. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels.

name: XL kmrun - Плана
description: XL Plana is a trail race included in the XLkmrun calendar and organized by 5kmrun. It takes place around the village of Plana, near Sofia, in the Plana Mountain. Participants can choose from three distances—5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km—over open terrain with varied conditions, including wet and sunny sections. The race is suitable for trail-running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Three distances: 5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km
The course is open, with no shade and varied terrain
Held in the Plana Mountain, near Sofia
additional: A choice of three distances of varying lengths. The course is mostly open, which can be challenging in strong sunlight. Organized by 5kmrun. The race is held annually in May around the village of Plana. Trail race; distances: 5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km; held around the village of Plana.

name: Луковит рън
description: The Lukovit Run road race is an annual 8.8-kilometer event that starts in the center of Lukovit and finishes at Prohodna Cave. It attracts runners of different ages and abilities, with past winners including Ismail Senandzhi and Marinela Nineva. The event is part of Lukovit Municipality’s sports calendar and offers a mass 800-meter start for younger participants. The course is scenic and challenging, combining urban and natural surroundings.
course_highlights: The 8.8-kilometer course runs from the center of Lukovit to Prohodna Cave
Includes a mass 800-meter start for younger participants
Takes place in scenic natural and urban surroundings
additional: The oldest participant was 70 years old. Winner Ismail Senandzhi has won the race five times. The event also includes a mass 800-meter start. It takes place on 10 May 2026, with cash prizes for the winners and medals for participants. The event is part of the Run Bulgaria series and is popular with running enthusiasts in the region.

description: The Rose Valley Marathon in Kazanlak is a sporting event for all running enthusiasts. The race offers three distances: a classic 42 km marathon, a 21 km half marathon, and a 10 km race. The start and finish are in Rosarium Park, in front of the Rose Museum in Kazanlak. The course passes through urban areas, bike paths, and a secondary road network, with approximately 100 meters of elevation gain. The event takes place on May 10, 2026, at 09:00 and features aid stations every 5 km, as well as prizes in various categories.

The course follows bike paths and a secondary road network
Approximately 100 meters of elevation gain

Aid stations along the course provide water, drinks, and fruit approximately every 5 km. The start/finish area has designated personal-bag storage zones with tags bearing race numbers. The awards ceremony begins at 13:00 and includes overall and youth categories. On-site registration is from 08:00 to 09:00, and the start is at 09:00. The event offers different distances and is suitable for runners of all levels.

name: Мемориал „Веселин Даскалов”
description: The Veselin Daskalov Memorial is a traditional athletics competition held in Lukovit, Bulgaria. The 20th anniversary edition took place at the city stadium, with more than 200 athletes from across the country competing in various distances from 100 m to 1500 m. The competition attracts both children and national-level athletes, creating opportunities for young talents and established sportspeople to compete. The organizers hold an official awards ceremony attended by local representatives and sports officials.
course_highlights: City stadium in Lukovit with a well-maintained track
Events from 100 m to 1500 m for different age groups
More than 200 athletes from 35 clubs across the country
additional: The competition includes different age groups, with distances from 100 m to 1500 m. Representatives of Lukovit Municipality and sports officials attend the awards ceremonies. The event is part of the region’s sports calendar and attracts national-level athletes and young talents. It is held at the city stadium in Lukovit, with distances from 100 m to 1500 m, includes children and adults, and features participants from across the country.

name: СТЕНАТА RUN 2026
description: STENATA RUN 2026 is a race held near Shumen Reservoir in the city of Shumen. The event offers different distances and formats, including individual and relay runs lasting from 1 to 6 hours. The course is suitable for runners with varying levels of fitness and goals, combining natural beauty with challenges. The organizers, Shumen Early Runners, invite you to take part in this dynamic and friendly race.
course_highlights: The course runs along Shumen Reservoir
Options for individual and relay running
A range of time formats: 1, 2, 3, and 6 hours
additional: Options include individual runs lasting 6 hours and 3 hours, as well as mixed relays lasting 2 hours and 1 hour (under 18 years old).

description: Crosul T.E.A.M. este un eveniment sportiv caritabil organizat în Timișoara, care combină mișcarea cu solidaritatea pentru a sprijini copiii din cadrul Asociației „Inima Îți Vorbește”. Evenimentul are un caracter participativ, fără cronometrare sau clasamente, și oferă o experiență plăcută pentru toate vârstele, cu curse dedicate bebelușilor, copiilor și adulților. Traseele includ zone centrale ale orașului, iar fondurile colectate susțin proiectul „Casa InimiiLor”, un refugiu terapeutic pentru copii. Participarea este o manifestare de solidaritate și speranță pentru cei care au nevoie.
course_highlights: Traseele includ Piața Libertății și Piața Victoriei, cu distanțe adaptate pe categorii de vârstă
Eveniment participativ fără cronometrare, toți participanții primesc medalii de participare
Sprijin caritabil pentru copiii Asociației „Inima Îți Vorbește” prin proiectul Casa InimiiLor
additional: Distribuția kiturilor de participare se face în zilele premergătoare evenimentului la sediul Wendhill Academy din Iulius Mall (etajul 2). Startul și finish-ul sunt în Piața Libertății. Participanții la cursele bebelușilor sunt purtați în marsupiu sau în brațe, iar cursele copiilor au reguli speciale privind însoțirea de către părinți sau tutori legali. Evenimentul are o deschidere oficială și ședință tehnică înaintea startului. Evenimentul promovează solidaritatea și implicarea comunității, fiind o oportunitate de a susține copiii din cadrul Asociației „Inima Îți Vorbește” prin participare și donații.

description: The Color Run Cluj-Napoca 2026 este o cursă de 5 kilometri plină de energie pozitivă, culoare și distracție, perfectă pentru toate vârstele și nivelurile de fitness. Evenimentul nu este cronometrat, accentul fiind pus pe bucuria alergării și pe experiența vibrantă a culorilor aplicate la fiecare kilometru. Traseul urban pornește și se termină în Piața Unirii, oferind o atmosferă de festival cu multiple starturi succesive și o explozie de pudră colorată la final. Participanții primesc un kit cu tricou, bandană, tatuaje temporare, medalie și pudră colorată, iar evenimentul promovează un stil de viață sănătos și comunitatea.
course_highlights: Traseu urban de 5 km în centrul Clujului, cu start și finish în Piața Unirii
Aplicare de pudră colorată la fiecare kilometru parcurs
Explozie de pudră colorată la final, acompaniată de muzică live
additional: Evenimentul are mai multe starturi succesive la interval de 5 minute, iar participanții trebuie să poarte numărul de concurs vizibil pe tricou. Nu există spațiu de depozitare bagaje. Participarea cu biciclete, role, trotinete sau animale de companie este interzisă. Brățara de acces se primește la intrarea în zona de eveniment pe baza numărului de participare și a tricoului. Medalia și pudra colorată se oferă la finish. Participanții primesc kit de participare cu tricou, număr de concurs, bandană, tatuaj, medalie și pudră colorată; evenimentul promovează un stil de viață sănătos și activ; nu permit animale de companie sau vehicule pe traseu.

name: EcoRun Moieciu ~ 2026
description: EcoRun Moieciu este un eveniment de alergare montană de top în România, ce se desfășoară în Moieciu de Sus. Concursul include curse de Maraton, Semi și Cros, precum și o cursă pentru copii, EcoKids. Traseele sunt compuse în proporție de 90% din drumuri forestiere și poteci montane, oferind o experiență autentică de alergare în natură, cu peisaje spectaculoase și o comunitate pasionată. Evenimentul promovează practici sustenabile și se desfășoară anual în luna mai, reunind alergători de toate nivelurile.
course_highlights: Traseu de maraton de aproximativ 42 km cu 2400 m diferență de nivel pozitiv
Traseu semi de aproximativ 28 km cu 1350 m diferență de nivel pozitiv
Traseu cros de aproximativ 14 km cu 750 m diferență de nivel pozitiv, majoritar pe drumuri forestiere și poteci montane
additional: Startul pentru Cros și Maraton se va da în două valuri, la ora 9:00 și 9:15, în funcție de timpul estimat la înscriere. Participanții la Maraton vor lua startul la ora 9:00, ora fiind afișată pe număr. Există o zonă de relaxare și Pasta Party după concurs la Vlahia Inn. EcoKids are starturi separate pe categorii de vârstă începând cu ora 15:00. Înscrierile pentru cursele principale se deschid pe 8 martie 2026 și se închid pe 1 mai 2026, în limita locurilor disponibile. Trasee montane, activități precum pasta party și ceremonii florale, accent pe sustenabilitate și practici eco-friendly

name: Turnu Roșu Challenge
description: Turnu Roșu Challenge este o competiție de alergare submontană ce se desfășoară pe poteci marcate în Turnu Roșu și pe dealurile de la poalele Munților Făgăraș, oferind un cadru natural spectaculos și o provocare pentru toate nivelurile de pregătire. Evenimentul include trei curse: semimaraton de 21 km, cros de 11 km și hiking de 7 km, fiecare adaptat pentru diferite tipuri de participanți, de la experimentați la cei care doresc o experiență relaxantă. Organizatorii pun accent pe siguranță, recuperare și socializare, oferind facilități precum sesiuni de stretching, masaj post-alergare, camping și activități pentru copii. Este o ocazie excelentă de a te bucura de natură, sport și comunitate în județul Sibiu.
course_highlights: Trasee pe poteci naturale, drum forestier și pășuni
Peisaje spectaculoase la poalele Munților Făgăraș
Trei curse adaptate pentru toate nivelurile de pregătire
additional: Participanții primesc medalie, număr de concurs, opțional bluză contra cost, voucher masă și gel carbohidrați. După cursă sunt oferite sesiuni de masaj regenerativ și stretching. În seara dinaintea competiției se organizează camping cu foc de tabără și film în aer liber. Există atelier de pictură pentru copii în timpul cursei. Traseele includ coborâri tehnice și trec prin zone pitorești, fiind ideale pentru pasionații de trail running montan.

name: Crosul Cetăților Suceava
description: Crosul Cetăților Suceava este o cursă de alergare populară ce se desfășoară în orașul Suceava, oferind participanților o experiență sportivă în aer liber, cu trasee adaptate pentru toate vârstele și nivelurile de pregătire. Evenimentul include curse pentru copii, o cursă populară și o cursă de cros, promovând mișcarea și spiritul comunitar. Participanții pot alerga pe trasee ce trec prin zone istorice și pitorești, înconjurate de cetăți și peisaje locale. Organizatorii asigură un kit de participare și premii pentru concurenți, încurajând implicarea și performanța sportivă.
course_highlights: Trasee prin zone istorice și cetăți din Suceava
Curse dedicate copiilor, cursă populară și cursă de cros
Eveniment pentru toate vârstele și nivelurile de pregătire
additional: Kitul de participare este garantat doar pentru persoanele înscrise și confirmate până la data de 30 iunie 2025. Evenimentul include curse pentru copii, cursă populară și cursă de cros, cu premii și kituri de participare. Există o comunitate activă TRIB care organizează și alte alergări și evenimente caritabile. Evenimentul include activități comunitare și diverse categorii de curse, cu detalii despre înscrieri și regulament pe site-ul oficial

name: Run to the Hills
description: Run To The Hills este o cursă de alergare montană organizată în Crasna, Jud. Sălaj, care are loc pe 16 mai 2026. Evenimentul invită pasionații de alergare să exploreze dealurile pitorești din zonă, oferind o experiență sportivă în natură. Este o oportunitate excelentă pentru alergători de toate nivelurile să se bucure de peisaje frumoase și de o atmosferă prietenoasă.
course_highlights: Traseu montan în zona Crasna, Jud. Sălaj
Peisaje naturale pitorești
Eveniment organizat în aer liber, pe 16 mai
additional: Evenimentul a avut deja ediții anterioare, cu rezultate și feedback pozitive, fiind o tradiție locală de promovare a sportului și sănătății.

name: SEMIMARATON FETESTI
description: Semimaratonul Fetești este un eveniment sportiv anual care aduce împreună alergători din regiune pentru curse de diferite distanțe, inclusiv semimaraton și crosuri. Organizatorii, Asociația Sportivă Feteștiul Aleargă, promovează sportul și sănătatea în comunitate, oferind o experiență plăcută și competitivă. Evenimentul are o tradiție în zonă și se desfășoară pe trasee variate, potrivite pentru toate nivelurile de alergători.
course_highlights: Traseu de semimaraton de 21 km
Crosuri de 10 km și 5 km
Categorie specială pentru campionii școlari (6-13 ani)
additional: semimaraton, informații despre înscriere disponibile pe site și Facebook, traseu local

name: SALOMON ULTRA TRAIL HUNGARY

description: The Salomon Ultra-Trail Hungary is Hungary’s most prestigious trail-running race, consisting of six separate distances and attracting around 1,500 trail runners in total. The race takes place across varied terrain, including dense, dark forests, with challenging climbs. The longest distance is 111 km, with 4,200 m of elevation gain, 9 aid stations, 2 drop bags, and a 20-hour cutoff. The race is held in Szentendre, with the start and finish at Lázár cár Square. A detailed map and an information center are available to runners and their accompanying supporters to help ensure the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: 111 km distance with 4,200 m of elevation gain
9 aid stations and 2 drop bags on the longest distance
Dense, dark forests and varied terrain
additional: The race has a maximum capacity of 1,600 participants, with 300 places available on the longest distance. The race’s Google map shows the aid stations, start and finish locations, and race headquarters. There are staffed crossings along the course where supporters are not allowed to cheer. The Dömös and Pap-rét aid stations cannot be reached by car and require a 30-minute walk. Registration for the race opens on November 2, 2025, with various entry options and activities associated with the event.

The event offers a great opportunity for anyone interested in running and exploring nature to enjoy sport and a sense of community. The race will be held on May 16, 2026, at the New Kayak House in Tata.

A natural setting, ideal for runners and nature lovers
A traditional mass-participation event involving several sports sections

name: Nebeski visovi – 4. kolo Nacionalne serije u planinskom trčanju
description: The Nebeski Visovi race in Zlatibor is the fourth round of the National Mountain Running Series, organized by the Tornik Mountaineering Club from Čajetina. Participants can choose between two loop courses: the longer red course, 21 km with 1,400 meters of elevation gain, intended for seniors, and the shorter blue course, 10 km with 500 meters of elevation gain, for juniors. The courses pass through Zlatibor’s unspoiled nature and over the peaks of Ljujaš, Orlić, Jelova Gora, Bandera-Tornik, and Liska, offering scenic, wild landscapes. The race attracts competitors from across Serbia and abroad. Scoring in the National Series is governed by the rules of the Mountaineering Association of Serbia, a member of the World Mountain Running Association.
course_highlights: Two loop courses: 21 km with 1,400 m of elevation gain and 10 km with 500 m of elevation gain
The courses pass over the peaks of Ljujaš (1,269 m), Orlić (1,235 m), Jelova Gora (1,311 m), Bandera-Tornik (1,496 m), and Liska (1,346 m)
The race passes through unspoiled nature and lesser-known parts of Zlatibor
additional: The race headquarters are at the primary school in the village of Jablanica. The race is part of the National Mountain Running Series, which includes five rounds for seniors and three races for juniors. Participation requires a validated PSS competition booklet or a medical certificate. Senior scoring includes bonus points for the national championship and ultra-trail races. The Mountaineering Association of Serbia is a member of the World Mountain Running Association (WMRA). Participants can expect challenging mountain courses, and the race is part of a wider national series promoting mountain running in Serbia.

name: Nebeski visovi 2026
description: The "Tornik" Mountaineering Club from Čajetina and the Mountaineering Association of Serbia invite you to take part in the unforgettable "Nebeski visovi" skyrace in the fairytale setting of Zlatibor, in the village of Jablanica. This race is the first event of the year in the Mountaineering Association of Serbia’s national mountain running series and is intended for athletes, recreational runners, and nature lovers. The race offers two loop courses, starting and finishing by the school in the center of Jablanica, and passing through areas with spectacular views. Participants can choose between the 21 km red course with 1,400 m of cumulative ascent and the 10 km blue course with 500 m of ascent.
course_highlights: Red course: 21 km, 1,400 m of cumulative ascent
Blue course: 10 km, 500 m of ascent
Loop courses start and finish by the school in Jablanica and pass through areas with beautiful views
additional: Race packet pickup on race day by the school in Jablanica, from 8:00 to 9:45. Red course start at 10:00; blue course start at 10:15. Categories include overall men’s and women’s, team, junior, senior, and veteran categories. Time limits are 4h30min for the red course and 3h for the blue course in the Mountaineering Association of Serbia competition, and 6h and 4h, respectively, in the open competition. Terrain includes mountain trails with significant climbs; on-site registration; categories for different age groups and team competition categories.

description: IHB Business Run Varna is the biggest team-building race in Bulgaria, held at the BulYard Shipyard and Bulport Logistics in Varna. It is a relay race for teams of 4, with each participant running 4 km before handing the relay baton to the next runner. The event combines sporting spirit and corporate teamwork, bringing together many companies and their employees in a dynamic, friendly format. In addition to the main race, there is also a Kids Run for children aged 4 to 12, supported by certified coaches.
course_highlights: Relay race with teams of 4, each running 4 km
The course is in the industrial zone of BulYard Shipbuilding Industry and Bulport Logistics
Each lap is 2 km, and each participant runs 2 laps
additional: Each participant receives a race bib and safety pins. The relay baton is equipped with an electronic timing chip. The start is at 9:00, and the first runner must be at the start with the baton at 8:50. Parking and a cloakroom are available next to the start area. Laser engraving on medals is available for an additional fee. Branded team tents are available for an additional fee. Registration deadlines are in early 2026. The event includes certificates and gifts, as well as the opportunity for companies to take part and enjoy team-building.

description: Timotion este cel mai mare eveniment sportiv caritabil din vestul României, care reunește anual mii de participanți, voluntari și susținători pentru a alerga, pedala și a face bine comunității. Evenimentul oferă curse diverse pentru toate vârstele și nivelurile de pregătire, de la ciclism și semimaraton, până la curse pentru copii și curse de distracție pe roți. Prin participare, alergătorii și cicliștii susțin proiecte comunitare și contribuie la dezvoltarea solidarității și speranței în regiune. Timotion este o mișcare a inimilor unite pentru bine, cu o tradiție de peste 10 ani și o comunitate în continuă creștere.
course_highlights: Cursa SMW de ciclism pe un traseu de 15 km, cronometrată, pentru participanți cu experiență
Semimaraton de 21 km și crosuri de 10 km, 5 km, 3 km pentru diverse categorii de vârstă

Multiple curse pe 10 mai, inclusiv ciclism, semimaraton și curse recreative; componentă de strângere de fonduri; oportunități de voluntariat

name: Accenture Heroes Challenge
location: Parcul Sportiv Universitar Iuliu Hațieganu, Cluj-Napoca, Cluj County, Romania
description: Accenture Heroes Challenge este o competiție intensă de teste de forță, viteză, agilitate și skill-uri, desfășurată în Parcul Sportiv Universitar Iuliu Hațieganu din Cluj-Napoca. Ediția a doua, programată pentru 17 mai 2026, provoacă participanții să își depășească limitele printr-un traseu cu obstacole. Evenimentul oferă două distanțe, 6 km și 12 km, pentru a satisface atât alergătorii experimentați, cât și pe cei care doresc o provocare mai scurtă.
course_highlights: Traseu cu obstacole ce testează forța, viteza și agilitatea

Distanțe disponibile: 6 km și 12 km

name: Crosul Sport4All

description: Crosul Sport 4 all este un eveniment sportiv de alergare organizat anual la Lugoj, destinat tuturor vârstelor și nivelurilor de pregătire. Evenimentul include curse ne-cronometrate pentru copii și cursa populară de 2 km, precum și curse cronometrate de 4 km și 6 km pentru participanții mai mari. Traseele sunt bucle în jurul Universității Europene Drăgan și pe străzile centrale ale orașului, oferind o experiență urbană plăcută. Participanții primesc medalii de participare, iar cursele sunt organizate cu categorii de vârstă pentru cursele cronometrate. Evenimentul este susținut de Primăria Lugoj și Universitatea Europeană Drăgan, cu 400 de locuri gratuite oferite de sponsorul Mondial S.A.
course_highlights: Trasee buclă în jurul Universității Europene Drăgan și pe străzile centrale din Lugoj
Curse pentru toate vârstele, inclusiv curse ne-cronometrate pentru copii și curse cronometrate de 4 km și 6 km
Medalii de participare pentru toți participanții la cursele ne-cronometrate

Evenimentul include festivitate de premiere pentru cursele cronometrate și sesiuni de încălzire și ședință tehnică înaintea startului. description: Maratonul Nisipului Run & Fun, ce va avea loc pe 17 mai 2026 la Plaja Zoom Beach din Constanța, este un eveniment sportiv care combină competiția cu distracția și promovarea unui stil de viață sănătos. Evenimentul oferă șase curse variate, de la maratonul de 42 km până la alergări recreative pentru întreaga familie, desfășurate pe nisipul litoralului românesc. Participanții se pot bucura de trasee spectaculoase cu briza mării, într-o atmosferă plină de energie și comunitate. Maratonul este o sărbătoare a mișcării, naturii și aventurii, adresată atât alergătorilor profesioniști, cât și amatorilor.
course_highlights: Trasee pe nisipul litoralului românesc cu briza mării
Puncte de hidratare la start/finish și la km 2.5 pe plaja Reyna
Traseu de dificultate moderat ridicată, cu bucle multiple și marcaje clare
additional: Startul se va da din inima vibrantă a Constanței, pe 17 mai 2026. Traseul maratonului constă în bucle de 7 km pe nisip, cu un timp limită de 6 ore. Multiple categorii de curse, trasee pe nisipul litoralului, activități pentru familii și comunitate, eveniment de promovare a unui stil de viață sănătos

description: Prima Evadare este cel mai mare maraton de ciclism cross country din România, desfășurat anual pe un traseu clasic între București și Snagov. Concursul oferă o experiență prietenoasă și accesibilă, cu o distanță de aproximativ 55 km prin păduri și drumuri de țară, fără diferențe mari de nivel. Evenimentul adună pasionați de ciclism din toată țara, oferind o atmosferă energică și prietenoasă, ideală pentru deschiderea sezonului de maratoane MTB.
course_highlights: Traseu de aproximativ 55 km prin păduri și drumuri de țară

Traseul clasic București - Snagov
additional: Ridicarea pachetului de participare se face în zilele de vineri și sâmbătă înaintea concursului, la Greenfield Plaza Băneasa. Participanții pot aștepta un traseu variat, cu terenuri naturale și peisaje diverse, fiind un eveniment de referință pentru mountain biking în România.

A unique medal awaits participants at the finish, making the day one to remember. The race is not only a test of physical endurance, but also a true adventure and experience. Everyone is warmly welcome.

name: Somborski polumaraton
description: The Sombor Half Marathon is a traditional race held in Sombor, featuring a new course through beautiful parts of the city. The event brings together many runners from Serbia and abroad, promoting a healthy lifestyle and recreational running. The organizers strive to make the race well organized and enjoyable for all participants, with special attention to the atmosphere and socializing. The race is part of the rich program of activities of the Somaraton Athletics and Recreation Club, which has fostered Sombor’s long-standing running tradition.
course_highlights: New course through Somborica
Organized transportation for participants
Medal for all participants
additional: Organized transportation to Somborica is available for participants; the contact person is Milan Kovačić. The celebration of ARK Somaraton’s 16th anniversary is part of the accompanying activities. Runners receive a medal for participating. The club has around 65 members, with active training sessions and support for runners of all levels. The event also includes organized city tours, cultural activities, and support during the race, and is open to all age groups.

name: ApriltsiRun
organizer: Община Априлци, Сдружение „Троян в бъдещето“, НД „Традиция“ – 34-ти Пехотен Троянски полк
description: ApriltsiRun is a mountain running event inspired by the heroic events of the April Uprising of 1876. The race follows historic trails around Mount Maragidik and Mount Botev, along which the insurgents traveled 150 years ago. The courses offer varying levels of difficulty, suitable for both professional runners and mountain running enthusiasts. The event brings together sport, nature, and history, marking the anniversary of the uprising with panoramic routes and a charitable cause.
course_highlights: Courses of varying difficulty: 3 km with 75 m of elevation gain, 8 km with 245 m of elevation gain, and 26 km with 1,514 m of elevation gain
Routes follow historic trails around Mount Maragidik and Mount Botev
Panoramic views and natural beauty in the Apriltsi area
additional: The organizers are Apriltsi Municipality, the Troyan in the Future Association, and the National Society “Tradition” – 34th Troyan Infantry Regiment. The race has a charitable focus, with funds raised allocated to causes related to the fight against cancer and the promotion of historical and natural heritage. The event is organized to bring together sport, history, and cultural heritage, offering different levels of difficulty and welcoming both professional runners and enthusiasts. It is held in honor of the 150th anniversary of the April Uprising.

name: Маратон Варна
description: Varna Marathon is one of the most exciting sporting events in the seaside capital, combining challenge, emotion, and unforgettable moments. The course runs along Varna’s beautiful coastline, offering fresh air and scenic sea views. The event attracts both local and international athletes, creating an atmosphere of sporting passion and support. Varna Marathon tests endurance and strength of spirit, inspiring participants to achieve new personal goals.
course_highlights: The course runs along Varna’s coastline, with sea views
The race takes place in Bulgaria’s seaside capital
An atmosphere of support from local fans and international participants

Race numbers can only be collected in person on race day from 07:00 to 09:00 at Independence Square, next to the Varna Opera House. The event also includes a 2 km city run with Decathlon. Distances: 42 km and 21 km; online and on-site registration; an event with a large number of participants and sponsors; held in Varna, Bulgaria.

name: Маратон на приятелството Плевен
description: The Pleven Friendship Marathon is a traditional event taking place on May 17, 2026, in the center of Pleven. The competition includes a marathon, half marathon, 10.55 km race, relay, and Vidas Run Kids children’s marathon. The certified courses pass through scenic parts of the city and Kaylaka Park. The event combines sport with a charitable cause supporting medical students. The organizers provide refreshment stations, medical services, and a varied program for race day.
course_highlights: The marathon consists of 4 laps with two turn-around points
Refreshment stations every 5–6 km and water stations every 3 km and along the course
The course passes through Kaylaka Park and scenic parts of Pleven

name: Спици и Бодли 2026
description: Spokes and Thorns 2026 is a cross-country mountain biking and duathlon race held in the foothills of the Balkan Mountains near Kazanlak. The race offers routes of varying difficulty, suitable for both beginners and advanced cyclists. In addition to the sporting competition, participants and guests can enjoy a festival featuring live music, outdoor cinema, yoga, horseback riding, and other activities. The event brings together sport, entertainment, and community in an unforgettable atmosphere.
course_highlights: The Hobby route is 37 km with 1,274 m of elevation gain, suitable for cyclists of all levels.
The Difficult route is 47 km with 1,781 m of elevation gain, featuring challenging climbs and technical descents for advanced riders.
The duathlon includes 37 km of cycling and 22 km of running, with the cycling route overlapping the Hobby route.
additional: Registration includes insurance for medical and rescue expenses, support for a charitable cause, aid stations with food and drinks, a medical team, and festival activities at the start/finish area, including live music, horseback riding, archery, and aerial yoga. A children’s race for children up to 12 years old takes place on 16.05.2026 at 17:00 near the start/finish area. It includes a children’s race, a tent campsite, insurance, aid stations, and charitable giving.

name: Dac Warrior
description: Dac Warrior 2026 este o cursă cu obstacole unică în România, ce se desfășoară pe 23 mai în Tohani, Gura Vadului, Prahova. Traseele sunt provocatoare, cu diferențe de nivel semnificative și obstacole diverse, menite să testeze atât rezistența fizică, cât și voința participanților. Evenimentul oferă o experiență de inițiere și reconectare cu spiritul strămoșilor daci, combinând efortul sportiv cu tradiția și natura autentică. Participanții pot alege dintre mai multe probe, de la 6 km până la 21 km, fiecare cu dificultăți și obstacole specifice. Atmosfera este una de camaraderie și luptă, iar după cursă, participanții sunt invitați să descopere cultura locală și să se bucure de tradiții și ritualuri.
course_highlights: Ultimate Run: 21 km cu 1060 m diferență de nivel și peste 30 de obstacole
Legend Run: 11.6 km cu 690 m diferență de nivel și 25 de obstacole
Brave Run: 7.35 km cu 348 m diferență de nivel și 20 de obstacole
additional: Validarea înscrierilor și ridicarea kiturilor se face vineri, 22 mai 2026, între 16:00 și 20:00, la Domeniul Satul Dacilor. Traseele includ obstacole diverse precum gardulețe, sărituri peste buștean, inele, saci de nisip, piramida de bușteni, frânghii, paralele, monkey bar, canal cu noroi, traversare perete și obstacol surpriză. Există categorii de premii pe vârste și gen, cu premii în bani pentru primele locuri. Cursa este recomandată pentru participanți cu experiență, mai ales pentru Ultimate Run, care este un OCR dificil. Evenimentul include diferite categorii de distanțe și trasee, fiind deschis atât pentru alergători amatori, cât și pentru cei avansați.

Participanții pot alege între curse de 5 km, 10 km și 21 km, iar evenimentul include și o competiție de cules struguri, tururi ghidate, activități pentru copii, donații caritabile și degustări de vin și mâncare tradițională.

name: Obciniada Night Run
organizer: Obciniada / Asociația Ținuturi Durabile / Asociația Club Sportiv Bucovina între Obcini
description: Obciniada Night Run este o cursă de alergare nocturnă în inima Bucovinei, ce oferă trasee spectaculoase și o atmosferă de festival sub stele. Evenimentul este organizat pentru a promova mișcarea în aer liber și un stil de viață sănătos, implicând comunitatea locală și susținând educația copiilor defavorizați. Participanții pot alege între mai multe distanțe, de la semimaraton la curse pentru copii, bucurându-se de o experiență autentică în natură, cu puncte de hidratare, masă caldă și premii. Festivalul combină sportul cu o atmosferă prietenoasă și responsabilă față de mediu.
course_highlights: Trasee nocturne spectaculoase în pădurile și culmile Bucovinei
Puncte de hidratare și alimentare pe parcursul traseului
Atmosferă de festival cu acces general și masă caldă la finish
additional: Participanții primesc număr personalizat cu cip de cronometrare, acces la punctele de hidratare și alimentare, brățară de acces general în zona festivalului, masă caldă la finish și premii în bani la categoriile de vârstă și OPEN. Festivalul oferă opțiuni de cazare în camping sau hoteluri partenere și recomandă transportul cu trenul sau autobuzul pentru un impact redus asupra mediului. Multiple distanțe de curse, atmosferă de festival, premii, rezultate în timp real, facilități pentru participanți, scop caritabil
