description: Urlea Super Vertical este o cursă montană extremă, ce se desfășoară în peisajele sălbatice ale Munților Făgăraș, oferind o experiență unică de alergare verticală și coborâre intensă. Este prima și singura ștafetă sus-jos din România, unde un partener urcă și celălalt coboară, adăugând un element inovator și spectaculos competiției. Traseul de 12 km cu o diferență de nivel de 1833 m pune la încercare atât rezistența, cât și tehnica alergătorilor, pe drum forestier, poteci prin păduri și pășuni alpine. Evenimentul este dedicat celor care caută adrenalină pură și o provocare montană intensă, cu un sistem revoluționar de premiere care recompensează performanța individuală și pe echipe.
course_highlights: Traseu de 12 km cu 1833 m diferență de nivel, până la 2474 m altitudine
Prima și singura ștafetă sus-jos din România, cu un partener care urcă și celălalt coboară
Teren variat: drum forestier, drum de taf, poteci prin păduri de foioase și conifere, pășune alpină
additional: Sistem de premiere revoluționar cu clasamente individuale și pe echipe, premii în bani pentru echipe și bonusuri pentru performanțe individuale. Kit-ul de participare include număr de concurs personalizat (pentru înscrierile timpurii), medalie de finisher gravată în piatră, maiou tehnic superlight pentru primii 300 înscriși, puncte de alimentare și hidratare, asistență medicală, și acces la sesiuni educaționale și ateliere. Parcarea disponibilă pentru 360 de automobile. Plata se face exclusiv cu card bancar, iar înscrierea este validă doar după plata integrală. Evenimentul include predare kit-uri, cazare cu corturi și sugestii de cazare, precum și start și premiere în ziua cursei.

name: Maratonul Târnavei
description: Maratonul Târnavei este un eveniment de trail running organizat de Asociația Târnăveni Cycling în colaborare cu Ruck Ventilatoare, desfășurat în municipiul Târnaveni, județul Mureș. Ajuns la a 10-a ediție, maratonul promovează un stil de viață sănătos și alergarea în natură, având ca scop creșterea educației ecologice și conștientizarea beneficiilor sportului în aer liber. Startul și finish-ul sunt amplasate în incinta companiei Ruck Ventilatoare, iar competiția include mai multe trasee de trail running pentru toate vârstele și nivelurile. Evenimentul reunește o comunitate de sportivi pasionați de alergare și respect față de mediul înconjurător.
course_highlights: Start și finish în incinta companiei Ruck Ventilatoare
Trasee de trail running variate: semimaraton 21 km, cros 10 km, cros 4 km și Kids Trail Running
Eveniment desfășurat în regiunea Transilvania, în natură
additional: Ridicarea kit-urilor se face în ziua anterioară și în ziua cursei, în incinta fabricii Ruck Ventilatoare. Există încălzire susținută de instructor fitness înainte de start. Sunt organizate curse pentru copii pe categorii de vârstă. După competiție are loc un Gulaș Party, concert și festivitatea de premiere. Participanții pot alege între trasee de 21 km, 10 km, 4 km și curse pentru copii, cu activități precum ridicarea kit-urilor, curse și ceremonii de premiere.

name: Cros Montan Traversare Igniș
description: Traversare Igniș este o competiție de alergare montană cu tradiție, ajunsă la ediția a 17-a, care aduce împreună alergători și iubitori ai muntelui din întreaga regiune. Evenimentul propune două probe desfășurate într-un cadru montan autentic, cu diferență de nivel reală și peisaje spectaculoase. Traseele includ un Cros de 14 km cu 1000 m diferență pozitivă de nivel și un Semimaraton de aproximativ 23 km cu 1450 m diferență pozitivă de nivel. Participanții beneficiază de kit de participare, puncte de hidratare și asistență medicală, iar finish-ul este la Pensiunea Mountain Pearl.
course_highlights: Traseu Cros: 14 km cu 1000 m diferență pozitivă de nivel, urcări susținute și coborâri tehnice
Traseu Semimaraton: aprox. 23 km cu 1450 m diferență pozitivă de nivel, provocare suplimentară
Peisaje spectaculoase și puncte de hidratare pe traseu
additional: Startul are loc la Podul Berdu, cartierul Ferneziu, la baza Lacului Firiza. Traseele sunt marcate cu panglici, indicatoare și vopsea. Kitul de participare include număr cu cip, tricou, medalie, acces la puncte de alimentare, asistență medicală și guiaș. Finish-ul este la Pensiunea Mountain Pearl, partener principal al evenimentului. Traseele sunt pe teren de munte, înscrierile se închid pe 9 iunie 2026, participarea include kit cu număr, tricou, medalie și puncte de hidratare, evenimentul are loc pe 20 iunie 2026.

description: Crosul Hoia GlobalLogic este o cursă de alergare organizată în Cluj-Napoca, care oferă participanților oportunitatea de a alerga pe potecile răcoroase din Pădurea Hoia. Evenimentul include probe de 15 km, 7 km, 3 km și o probă dedicată familiilor, fiind potrivit pentru alergători de toate vârstele și nivelurile. Organizatorii Runners Club promovează o atmosferă prietenoasă și susțin comunitatea locală de alergători. Crosul are loc în iunie, schimbând asfaltul urban cu natura și oferind o experiență de alergare în aer liber.
course_highlights: Traseu pe potecile răcoroase din Pădurea Hoia
Probe de 15 km, 7 km, 3 km și proba familiei
Eveniment organizat în aer liber, în natură
additional: Pachetul de înscriere include număr de concurs și alte beneficii. Premii sunt oferite pe categorii. Evenimentul este organizat de Runners Club, care susține antrenamente de grup gratuite în Cluj-Napoca. Evenimentul are loc în pădurea Hoia, cu înscrieri online și medalii pentru participanți. Traseul include poteci naturale, fiind potrivit pentru alergători de toate vârstele și nivelurile.

name: Maratonul Roșia Montană - Cursa Copiilor ~ 2026
location: Centrul istoric al Roșia Montană, Alba, Romania
description: Maratonul Roșia Montană este o sărbătoare a naturii, istoriei și patrimoniului cultural, desfășurată în inima Munților Apuseni, în comuna Roșia Montană. Traseele variate, ce includ cărări montane, drumuri comunale și porțiuni asfaltate, oferă o experiență unică atât alergătorilor montani, cât și celor de alergare stradală. Evenimentul include curse pentru toate vârstele, inclusiv Cursa Copiilor, care se desfășoară pe trasee adaptate pe categorii de vârstă, în centrul istoric al localității. Participanții pot admira pe parcurs peisajele naturale și patrimoniul arhitectural vechi de secole.
course_highlights: Trasee variate cu diferențe de altitudine pe cărări montane și drumuri comunale
Peisaje naturale din Munții Apuseni și patrimoniu arhitectural vechi în Roșia Montană
Cursa Copiilor pe trasee adaptate pe categorii de vârstă în centrul istoric
additional: Cursa Copiilor are trasee diferite în funcție de vârstă, de la 700 m pentru copii 0-10 ani (cu părintele/tutorele obligatoriu pentru 0-6 ani) până la 2.3 km pentru copii 13-16 ani. Startul și sosirea sunt în Piața Centrală din Roșia Montană. Evenimentul include și alte curse: Maraton 42,16 km, Semimaraton 25,2 km și Cros 10 km. Kit-uri de participare se ridică în Piața Centrală cu o zi înainte, iar programul include și activități culturale și concerte. Cursa copiilor include trei trasee diferite (700 m, 1.3 km, 2.3 km), cu premii și medalii pentru participanți. Evenimentul are loc în data de 21 iunie 2026, în centrul istoric al comunei, și promovează valorile culturale și ecologice ale zonei.

name: I. Szentivánéji Futótűz 5 / 10 / 21
description: The 1st Midsummer Night Run is a night-time running festival in the Lakeside Park in Balatonszárszó, held on Midsummer’s Eve. Participants can choose from several distances, including a half marathon, shorter races, and an evening walk along the shore of Lake Balaton. The event celebrates the start of the summer season and welcomes families and community sports enthusiasts as well as runners. The race is part of the Ötpróba program, which offers the opportunity to collect points for valuable rewards.
course_highlights: Night running along the shore of Lake Balaton
400 m children’s race on a traffic-free route in Lakeside Park
Refreshment point at approximately 2.6 km on the 5.25 km course
additional: Race number collection starts at 10:00 in Lakeside Park. Relay handovers take place at the finish arch by passing on the chip-equipped race number; using a race number belt is recommended. The entry fee includes refreshments (dextrose tablets, biscuits, salted pretzels, mineral water, squash, and gummy sweets). Balatonszárszó residents receive a 30% discount, and a season discount is also available based on previous participation. A technical T-shirt can be purchased separately (8,500 HUF). The event supports the Ötpróba program and offers discounts for local participants and season pass holders, as well as various running options and prizes.

name: SZENT LÁSZLÓ TEREPFUTÁS
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The Szent László Trail Run is a traditional trail-running race in the Gerecse Mountains, near Baj, organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association. The race is held in honor of Saint Ladislaus, the patron saint of the infantry and the firearms branch. It has taken place regularly since 2010, with only one cancellation, in 2013, due to flooding. Runners test their strength on varied terrain, forest trails, and hilly routes. This friendly community event is recommended for anyone interested in both nature and sport.
course_highlights: Varied terrain in the Gerecse Mountains
Forest trails and hilly sections
A scenic, challenging course close to nature
additional: The race is organized by the Tata Mass Sport and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association, which has several departments, including athletics and triathlon, orienteering, hiking, sport shooting, and other sports. The race is traditionally held in June, and the 2026 edition will be the 16th. Maps and past results are available to competitors on the organizer’s website. Mountain trail running, annual event, multiple distances and categories; detailed information is not provided

name: BALATON BAJNOKSÁG
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 km, 24 km, 12 km, 5 km, 5 km

name: Ultramaraton Palić
price_range: 50 € donacija po disciplini, startnina 50 € za strane državljane, smeštaj od 30-50 € po noći
description: The Palić Ultramarathon is a national and international ultramarathon championship held in Palić and organized by the Ultramarathon Association of Serbia. The event features several disciplines: 6-, 12- and 24-hour races, as well as 50 km and 100 km races, with the start and finish at the Great Terrace. The competition is open to all ultramarathoners who follow the rules, with participants competing in the overall and age categories. Alongside the competitive spirit, the event offers a well-stocked aid station, a communal lunch and prizes for the top finishers, as well as special prizes for the youngest and oldest participants.
course_highlights: 6-, 12- and 24-hour races
50 km and 100 km races
Start and finish at the Great Terrace in Palić
additional: Accommodation is arranged in hotels and motels, with a shared tent also available for competitors who do not need overnight accommodation. A well-stocked aid station is available during the race, followed by a communal lunch for all participants. Prizes are awarded in the overall and age categories, including special prizes for the youngest and oldest participants. The event includes recreational training sessions, competitions and the promotion of ultramarathoning in the region, and takes place in June 2026.

name: Trka prijateljstva Kula
location: Kula, South Bačka District, Vojvodina, Serbia
description: The Friendship Race in Kula is a traditional event held since 2009 that promotes sport, friendship, family values, and recreation. The race brings together amateur, recreational, and professional runners from the region and beyond, creating a unique running community. Over the years, it has become the largest sporting event in the municipality of Kula, with more than 6,000 participants and a total of 34,000 kilometers run. The organizers continuously improve the event, prizes, and organization to make the race even better and more appealing to all participants.
course_highlights: Promotes sport and friendship
Large-scale regional event
Long-standing tradition since 2009
additional: The Friendship Race is the largest sporting event in the municipality of Kula and brings together runners from across the region. The organizers are committed to continuously improving the event and the running community. The Kula Running League is a related activity that brings runners together throughout the year and has a significant history and number of participants. Participants can run on a 5 km or 10 km course, with special safety measures in place during the COVID-19 pandemic. The organization also includes support with registration locations and transport from Belgrade.

name: Зелените пирамиди 2026 - бягане и колоездене
organizer: Колездачен клуб „Берое“ и Творчески колектив „На улицата“
description: Green Pyramids 2026 is the third edition of a running and cycling event held in Bedечka Park and on the southern slopes of Sredna Gora near Stara Zagora. The event offers a range of distances for children and adults, including a trail half marathon, and is part of the “Na Zeleno” festival. The courses pass by the three ritual Thracian burial mounds known as the Green Pyramids and are suitable for different fitness levels. Participants receive a race pack with a race number and course support.
course_highlights: 21 km trail half marathon passing the three ritual Thracian burial mounds known as the “Green Pyramids”
Cross-country cycling routes of 21, 33 and 65 km near the city
Routes of varying difficulty, suitable for all fitness levels
additional: Participation is free for children up to 12 years old. The event is part of the “Na Zeleno” festival, June 19–21, in Bedечka Park. The 33 km route is ridden twice for the 65 km distance. The 33 km and 65 km routes are part of the Bulgarian Cycling Federation’s Bulgaria Cup, with different categories. The festival includes sporting competitions, workshops, music, cinema and food; a new location has been added—the Cypress Grove.

name: Национален шампионат
description: The 16th Bulgarian National Folklore Championship “Euro Folk 2026” takes place in Veliko Tarnovo, Bulgaria. This is a traditional event organized by the European Association of Folklore Festivals (EAFF), aiming to preserve, develop, and promote Bulgarian and European folklore through festivals and competitions. The championship includes various categories such as dance, choirs, singing, orchestras, and customs, with an emphasis on authentic and arranged folk performances. The event is part of EAFF’s long-standing tradition and is held annually in the historic Bulgarian capital, Veliko Tarnovo.
course_highlights: Folklore competitions and performances by traditional Bulgarian groups
International participation and exchange of cultural traditions
Opportunities to take part in or observe cultural events and workshops
additional: Participants submit applications through an online form on the official website. The event includes categories for adults and children, covering different folk genres in a competitive format. The organizer is the European Association of Folklore Festivals, accredited by UNESCO to provide advisory services in the field of intangible cultural heritage. The festival features participants from across Bulgaria, a rich program of cultural events, awards, and opportunities to exchange traditions.

name: ISKRA Trail Kosmaj

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Uplatom startnine do 19.5. osiguravate svoj učesnički paket sa majicom

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Iskra Kosmaj Trail is a trail race held on the beautiful Kosmaj mountain, giving participants the chance to enjoy dense forests and breathtaking views. The race is a great opportunity for an outing and socializing in the race village located in the start and finish area. Three distances are available, and the race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers of all ages; participants under 18 need parental consent. The organizer guarantees safety and a great atmosphere, and participants receive a race pack with a T-shirt if they register on time.
course_highlights: Trails through the dense forests of Kosmaj mountain
Beautiful viewpoints and natural landscapes
A race village with food, drinks, and music in the start and finish area
additional: The total number of participants is limited to 1,000. Race packs can be collected in Belgrade ten days before the race. Entry fees are non-refundable, but participation can be gifted or transferred to the following year. Changing and leaving belongings is at participants’ own discretion. The race is also open to walkers and Nordic walkers. Registration is open until June 10, 2025. The start is scheduled for 08:00 in the morning, and the race takes place near the monument to the Kosmaj Partisan Detachment. Participants will be able to enjoy nature and visit local attractions after the race.

name: PIRIN RUN
description: Pirin Ultra is a mountain ultramarathon held in Pirin National Park, a UNESCO-listed site. The race offers several distances suited to skyrunning and mountain-running enthusiasts, with stunning views and challenging terrain. Participants can enjoy a unique experience amid Bulgaria’s natural scenery, combining sport and adventure. The event takes place in Bansko and attracts runners from around the world.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain in Pirin National Park, a UNESCO-listed site
Stunning views and a skyrunning course
A range of distances: 25 km, 38 km, 68 km, and 160 km
additional: For the 38 km and 160 km distances, 2 and 4 ITRA points, respectively, from a previous race are required to register. Registration and gear checks are mandatory and take place at designated times before the start. Transport to the start area is provided for the 25 km distance. The awards ceremony takes place at Central Square in Bansko. A multi-distance race featuring an ultramarathon and mountain routes, with exceptional natural views.

name: XL kmrun - Парк Врана
description: XL Vrana is a race on the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun and held in Vrana Park in Sofia. The course is well known and consists of a loop of around 5 km with minimal elevation gain. Participants can choose from three distances—short (5 km), medium (10 km), and long (15 km)—making it suitable for runners of different levels.
course_highlights: The course is a loop of around 5 km
Held in Vrana Park, on the outskirts of Sofia
Minimal elevation gain along the course
additional: The race offers three distances: 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km. The course is one loop of around 5 km, repeated according to the chosen distance. The minimal elevation gain makes it suitable for runners with varying levels of fitness. The event is part of the XLkmrun calendar and offers different distances. It is held in Vrana Park, Sofia.

name: Шуменско плато 2026
location: Паметник 'Създатели на българската държава', Шумен, Шумен, Bulgaria
description: Shumensko Plateau 2026 is a race taking place on June 21, 2026, in Shumensko Plateau Nature Park, with the start and finish next to the Monument to the Founders of the Bulgarian State in the city of Shumen. Organized by Veloclub Ilchov Bair, the event includes cycling, eMTB, duathlon, and trail running. Participants compete on various courses and are required to follow safety and environmental protection rules. The race is suitable for enthusiasts of mountain biking and running in natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Courses in Shumensko Plateau Nature Park with varied terrain
Start and finish next to the Monument to the Founders of the Bulgarian State
Includes cycling, eMTB, duathlon, and trail running
additional: Registration and race number pickup take place on 21.06.2026 from 06:00 to 08:00 and from 16:00 to 20:00 at the information center next to the Monument to the Founders of the Bulgarian State. Wearing a helmet and gloves is mandatory for cyclists. For eMTB participants, bicycles must meet EU requirements, with a speed limit of 25 km/h and a power limit of 250 W. The use of chips that remove electric bicycle restrictions is prohibited. Participants under 18 must provide a written declaration from a parent. Disciplines include eMTB, cycling, running, and duathlon; registration and technical instructions will be provided on site.

name: Rodnei Sky Race
description: Rodnei Sky Race este o competiție montană de alergare desfășurată în Munții Rodnei, în zona Borșa, Maramureș. Evenimentul oferă trei trasee distincte, adaptate pentru diferite niveluri de experiență: traseul Puzdrelor, cel mai dificil, destinat alergătorilor experimentați; traseul Gărgălău, o provocare medie pentru alergători pregătiți; și traseul Musceta, un traseu rapid cu diferență mare de coborâre. Cursa face parte din Circuitul Carpaților și pune accent pe experiența alergării în natură, printre peisaje montane spectaculoase. Organizatorii invită familiile și pasionații de sporturi montane să participe la un weekend activ în aer liber.
course_highlights: Traseul Puzdrelor: 29.5 km cu 2200 m diferență de nivel, recomandat alergătorilor experimentați
Traseul Gărgălău: 21 km cu 1300-1500 m diferență de nivel, potrivit pentru alergători pregătiți, dar mai puțin experimentați
Traseul Musceta: 16 km cu 500 m urcare și 1500 m coborâre, traseu rapid și tehnic
additional: Locația cursei este Borșa, în Munții Rodnei, o zonă montană cu peisaje spectaculoase și o tradiție în sporturile montane. Există multiple opțiuni de cazare în apropierea startului, de la pensiuni la campinguri, la distanțe între 190 m și 17.6 km de start. Traseele combină poteci marcate și nemarcate, drumuri forestiere și pante abrupte, oferind o experiență autentică de alergare montană. Cursa face parte din Circuitul Carpaților de Alergare Montană. Traseu montan cu verificare echipament obligatoriu, start de la baza telegondolei din Borșa, descărcare GPX, și informații despre cazări și înscrieri. Taxele includ puncte de hidratare, fotografii, gulas și acces la parcare.

name: Sinaia Mountain Run
location: Piața Primăriei Sinaia, Sinaia, Prahova County, Romania
description: Sinaia Mountain Run by Constantina Diță este o cursă montană spectaculoasă cu startul și sosirea în Piața Primăriei Sinaia. Traseele trec prin zone pitorești precum Cota 1000 și Cota 1400, oferind alergătorilor o experiență montană autentică și provocatoare. Evenimentul este deschis atât alergătorilor de elită, cât și pasionaților de alergare montană, cu curse de 10K și 21K. Participanții primesc kit de concurs cu număr, chip de cronometrare și medalie, iar organizatorii oferă galerii foto digitale gratuite.
course_highlights: Traseu montan cu urcări până la Cota 1000 și Cota 1400
Trecere prin zone turistice marcate cu bandă roșie și galbenă
Start și sosire în Piața Primăriei Sinaia, pe Bd. Carol
additional: Ridicarea kit-urilor se face exclusiv în persoană pe baza actului de identitate. Timpul maxim pentru parcurgerea traseului de 10K este de 4.5 ore, iar pentru 21K este de 6 ore. Participarea minorilor între 14 și 18 ani este permisă doar însoțiți de un adult cu acord scris. Tricoul oficial este opțional și se poate achiziționa separat la 50 RON, iar tricoul special pentru copii este gratuit. Accesul pe traseu este permis doar participanților cu număr valid, oficialilor și personalului autorizat. Traseele includ teren montan variat, cu detalii despre curse și atracții culturale și istorice din zonă, precum Castelul Peleș și Mănăstirea Sinaia.

name: Cluj Running Festival
description: Cluj Running Festival este un eveniment internațional de alergare pe șosea, desfășurat în inima Clujului, care aduce la start atât atleți de elită, cât și mii de alergători amatori și copii. Festivalul combină sportul de performanță cu bucuria mișcării și energia orașului, oferind un traseu plat și rapid, ideal pentru toate nivelurile de alergători. Evenimentul include curse dedicate copiilor, curse open de 5 km și 10 km, precum și o cursă de elită cu atleți internaționali de top. Cluj-Napoca, un oraș tânăr și activ, oferă cadrul perfect pentru această sărbătoare a alergării.
course_highlights: Traseu plat și rapid în inima orașului Cluj-Napoca
Curse dedicate copiilor cu distanțe adaptate vârstei
Prezența atleților de elită internaționali și români
additional: Cursele pentru copii se desfășoară sâmbătă, 27 iunie, iar cursele pentru adulți și elită duminică, 28 iunie. Distante copii: 800 m (6-9 ani), 1200 m (10-13 ani), 3000 m (13-15 ani). Curse amatori: 5 km (minim 14 ani), 10 km (minim 16 ani). Evenimentul este organizat de echipa din spatele Brașov Running Festival. Toți participanții la cursele copiilor primesc medalii și surprize. Include curse pentru copii, categorii deschise și competiție internațională de elită cu etichetă World Athletics; evenimentul are loc în Cluj-Napoca și promovează alergarea urbană.

name: CROSUL ORASULUI MIOVENI 1485
description: Crosul Orașului Mioveni este un eveniment sportiv anual organizat de Asociația Invictus Mioveni în parteneriat cu Primăria și Centrul Cultural al orașului Mioveni. Evenimentul reunește alergători de toate vârstele, de la copii de 3 ani până la seniori de 78 de ani, pe trasee variate de 2,5 km, 5 km și 10 km, plus curse speciale pentru cei mici. Atmosfera este vibrantă, cu muzică, aplauze, demonstrații SMURD și momente artistice, oferind o zi dedicată sănătății, comunității și distracției sportive. Crosul este o sărbătoare a mișcării și a spiritului comunitar, susținută de sponsori importanți precum TEMAD, WD-40 România și UHU România.
course_highlights: Trasee de 2,5 km, 5 km și 10 km în Centrul Civic al orașului Mioveni
Curse speciale “DINO” pentru copii
Atmosferă vibrantă cu muzică, demonstrații SMURD și momente artistice
additional: Evenimentul include tombole cu premii și surprize pentru participanți, oferite de sponsori precum UHU și WD-40. Participanții sunt atât adulți, cât și copii, iar cel mai tânăr alergător a avut 3 ani, iar cel mai în vârstă 78 de ani. Trasee de 2,5 km, 5 km și 10 km, curse pentru copii, eveniment de promovare a sănătății și sportului, sprijin din partea sponsorilor TEMAD, WD-40 și UHU România.

description: Crosul Hoia GlobalLogic este o cursă de alergare organizată în Pădurea Hoia, Cluj-Napoca, care oferă participanților oportunitatea de a alerga pe poteci răcoroase în natură. Evenimentul include probe de 15 km, 7 km, 3 km și o probă dedicată familiilor, fiind potrivit pentru toate vârstele și nivelurile de pregătire. Organizatorii Runners Club promovează o atmosferă prietenoasă și susțin comunitatea locală de alergători. Crosul este o ocazie excelentă de a schimba asfaltul urban cu aerul curat și peisajele frumoase ale pădurii.
course_highlights: Trasee pe poteci răcoroase în Pădurea Hoia
Probe variate: 15 km, 7 km, 3 km și proba familiei
Eveniment potrivit pentru toate vârstele și nivelurile de alergare
additional: Pachetul de înscriere include tricou tehnic și număr de concurs. Premii pentru câștigători la fiecare probă. Evenimentul este organizat de Runners Club, care oferă și antrenamente de grup gratuite în Cluj-Napoca. Traseu pe potecile pădurii Hoia, înscriere online, taxa include medalie, cronometrare și asistență medicală

name: Crosul Oraşului Mioveni 1485 - Ed. a - IV - a ~ 2026
location: Centrul civic, Mioveni, Argeș County, Romania
description: Crosul Orașului Mioveni este un eveniment sportiv organizat de Invictus România, dedicat promovării spiritului de solidaritate și curaj, în special în rândul militarilor răniți. Evenimentul are loc în centrul civic al orașului Mioveni și face parte dintr-o serie de competiții sportive cu caracter caritabil și comemorativ. Participanții sunt încurajați să se alăture pentru a susține valorile de onoare și respect, într-un cadru prietenos și motivant.
course_highlights: Traseu desfășurat în centrul civic al orașului Mioveni
Eveniment dedicat militarilor răniți și veteranilor de război
Atmosferă de solidaritate și susținere comunitară
additional: Evenimentul include mai multe activităţi sportive, însă detaliile despre traseu şi înscrieri nu sunt specificate

name: 32. DECATHLON Futóest
description: The 32nd Decathlon Night Run is a special night race in the heart of Budapest, taking place at the illuminated Heroes’ Square and along Andrássy Avenue. Runners can compete in quarter-marathon, half-marathon, pairs and trios, while enjoying the city’s magical nighttime atmosphere. Thousands of runners from towns and cities across the country take part, and every participant receives a unique finisher’s medal and a finisher’s pack. The race starts at 21:00 on the evening of June 27, 2026, giving runners the chance to experience running amid the city lights.
course_highlights: Run through Budapest’s historic Heroes’ Square and along Andrássy Avenue
A night run through the illuminated city, with a special play of light and shadow
Join thousands of runners and receive a unique finisher’s medal and finisher’s pack
additional: Online registration is available only by bank card or SZÉP Card. On-site registration at the event venue opens at 18:30. Assistance with generating a unique email address is available for minors and people without an email address. A limited-edition technical running shirt can be ordered in advance. Several distances and team races (pairs and trios) are available. Every participant receives a unique finisher’s medal and finisher’s pack. night race, multiple distances, city center route, online registration, promotional merchandise available

name: KIPRUN FUTÓEST
price_range: kedvezményes nevezési díjak a március 30-ig tartó előnevezésnél
description: The 32nd Decathlon Running Night is a special night race in the heart of Budapest, on illuminated Heroes’ Square and Andrássy Avenue. Runners can enjoy the city’s magical atmosphere over quarter-marathon and half-marathon distances, where history and sport meet. Several thousand runners from towns and cities across the country take part, and participants are welcomed with a unique finisher’s medal. The race is an ideal choice for anyone looking to experience a summer night run at an iconic location.
course_highlights: Run through Budapest’s historic Heroes’ Square and along Andrássy Avenue
Illuminated urban setting with a nighttime atmosphere
Quarter-marathon and half-marathon distances
additional: Registration is available exclusively online at nevezes.futanet.hu. Payment can be made by bank card or SZÉP card. A BSI account registered with a unique email address is required to enter. A limited-edition technical running T-shirt can also be pre-ordered for the race. Running T-shirt available for purchase, training plans, multiple distances, night running, urban setting

name: TÖRÖKBÁLINTI HENDIKEP
description: The Törökbálint Handicap is a friendly running race with a voluntary entry fee, held in Dióskert. Runners can complete the half-marathon distance by running four laps, but they may also run fewer laps. The event has a welcoming, family atmosphere. All participants are offered an apple, hot tea and mulled wine, and receive a commemorative medal. The top three male and female runners also receive a special medal. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:00.
course_highlights: The course is in Dióskert, in a natural setting
The half-marathon consists of 4 laps, but runners can choose to run fewer
A friendly, family atmosphere, with a voluntary entry fee per lap
additional: Registration takes place at the venue. The suggested voluntary entry fee is 500 Ft per lap. All participants are offered an apple, hot tea and mulled wine. The awards ceremony is at 12:00. Every participant receives a commemorative medal, and the top three male and female runners also receive a special medal. The half-marathon is 4 laps; runners can do fewer laps. Registration is on site. Refreshments and commemorative medals.

name: Holló a Kövön, Várfutás - Palóc TM Kupa
Noćni maraton
location: Novi Sad, South Bačka District, Serbia
organizer: Tletsko rekreativni klub “Fruška gora” – Novi Sad
description: The Novi Sad Night Marathon is one of the most attended races in Serbia and a unique nighttime athletics and recreational event. The main race is the 42 km marathon, which demands dedication and mental strength, while the half marathon attracts the most participants and brings the special energy of a night race. There is also a mini-marathon for children and Nordic walking, making the event accessible to all ages and fitness levels. The race has become a tradition and a source of pride for Novi Sad, with carefully organized race packages and a rich experience on the course and after the race.
course_highlights: A night race through the streets of Novi Sad
A 42.2 km marathon as the main event
A half marathon with mass participation and a unique atmosphere
additional: Race packs can be collected the day before and on race day. Participants receive a technical shirt, a bib with a chip, a finisher’s medal, on-course refreshments, and a post-race massage. Registration is available only through the trka.rs portal; registration on race day is not allowed. Participants under 18 cannot enter the marathon, and parental consent is required for the mini-marathon and half marathon. The event includes several race distances and a Nordic walk, with registration through the trka.rs platform. It is scheduled for late June 2026, with registration and program details available on the official website.

name: Mala Sveta Gora
description: The Mala Sveta Gora running race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Ovčar Banja and offers three running categories: 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km). The race is known for its challenging course through nature, offering runners a unique experience and the opportunity to compete over different distances. The organizers invite all running enthusiasts to take advantage of promotional prices and take part in this sporting event, which brings together runners from across the region.
course_highlights: Routes through the natural surroundings of Ovčar Banja
Three categories: 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km
A challenging and varied running route
additional: The event is connected with local cultural and historical landmarks and natural beauty, and takes place within Ovčar Banja’s broader tourism and sporting setting.

name: TORNIK RACE 2026
description: Tornik Race is a unique running adventure on Zlatibor that combines adrenaline-fueled challenges with nature conservation. The races are designed for all ages and ability levels, with 6 km, 15 km and 25 km courses, as well as children’s races. Participants can enjoy Tornik’s natural beauty, test their endurance and contribute to protecting the environment through the Plogging Race. The organizers aim to build a community of passionate runners and nature lovers, offering an unforgettable experience and a healthy sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Courses through Tornik’s natural landscapes in three distances: 6 km, 15 km and 25 km
A Plogging Race combining running with cleaning up nature
Children’s OCR races with obstacles suited to different age groups
additional: The children’s OCR races take place on 27.06.2026 at 9:30, with categories based on age and course length. Competitor registration is on Friday from 17:00 to 20:00 and Saturday from 08:00 to 09:00. The Plogging Race combines running with an environmental cleanup activity. Registration is required for the children’s races, and participation is free. All participants receive race T-shirts and medals, while the top finishers receive gift packages. Trail and environmental activities, multiple course distances, a children’s obstacle race, registration required for the children’s race, date: 27.06.2026.

name: 17. Noćni maraton
description: The Novi Sad Night Marathon is one of the most popular races in Serbia and a unique nighttime athletics and recreational event. The main event is the 42 km marathon, which requires dedication and mental strength, while the half marathon attracts the most participants and brings the special energy of a night race. There is also a mini-marathon for the youngest runners and Nordic walking, making the event accessible to everyone. The organizers, ARK Fruška gora, continually improve the event, which has become a tradition and a source of pride for Novi Sad.
course_highlights: A night race along Sunčani kej in Novi Sad
A range of distances: marathon, half marathon, mini-marathon, and Nordic walking
An organized aid station and post-race massage
additional: Race packs can be collected the day before and on race day. The participant pack includes a technical T-shirt, a bib with a chip, a finisher’s medal, on-course refreshments, a bag drop, beer, post-race massage, and sponsor gifts. Adults are eligible to participate, while minors may take part only in the mini-marathon and half marathon with the consent of a parent or guardian. The race includes participant packs, medals, aid stations with water and fruit, and rules for fair and safe competition.

name: 2. Dr Milk TORNIK RACE
description: Tornik Race is a unique running adventure on Zlatibor that combines adrenaline-filled challenges with nature conservation. The races are suitable for all generations and levels, with 6 km, 15 km and 25 km courses, as well as children’s races. Participants can enjoy Tornik’s natural beauty, test their endurance and contribute to environmental conservation through the Plogging race. The organizers aim to build a community of passionate runners and adventure lovers, offering an unforgettable experience and encouraging a healthy sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Trails through Tornik’s natural surroundings in three distances: 6 km, 15 km and 25 km
A Plogging race combining running with cleaning up nature
Children’s OCR races with obstacles adapted to different age groups
additional: The children’s OCR races take place on 27.06.2026 at 9:30, with categories based on age and course length. Participant registration is Friday 17:00–20:00 and Saturday 08:00–09:00. The Plogging race promotes environmental awareness and cleaning up nature while running. Race starts are in the morning at Tornik Ski Center, and registration and information are available via the official email. Trail races of 6 km, 15 km and 25 km, a Plogging activity to protect nature, a children’s race, and an environmental focus.

name: Columbia Triton Trail
description: Columbia Triton Trail 2026 is an exciting trail running race in Nagybörzsöny, Hungary, organized by Trailrun.hu and Andrew Erdei. The race offers a unique experience for runners who enjoy being close to nature and taking on a challenge. The event takes place on June 28, where participants can test their strength and endurance on varied terrain in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Trail running through varied natural surroundings
Beautiful forest and mountain sections
Challenging climbs and technical sections
additional: The race takes place in Nagybörzsöny, Hungary. Participants can choose from different distances, and the event is characterized by its closeness to nature and its community atmosphere.

name: Rácalmás Szigetfutás
location: Jankovich Kúria, Rácalmás, Tolna County, Hungary
description: The Rácalmás Island Run is a friendly, family-oriented trail-running event held in the scenic surroundings of Rácalmás, on the protected Nagy Island and along the banks of the Danube. The varied terrain features shaded forest trails, views across farmland, riverside routes and paved sections, with minimal elevation gain. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and provide accessible sporting opportunities for all ages, whether running, walking or cycling. The event centre is the historic Jankovich Manor, an ideal venue for the start and finish as well as the accompanying activities. Participants can look forward to custom medals and T-shirts, and a friendly atmosphere close to nature.
course_highlights: Routes on the protected Nagy Island and along the Danube
Varied terrain: forest trails, views across farmland and paved sections
Minimal elevation gain; routes pass beneath shady trees and beside a picturesque boat harbour
additional: Race number collection is from 8:00 to 10:00. Several aid stations are available along the courses. Participation is free for RSE members, but registration is required. On-site registration is available in limited numbers only; advance registration is recommended. Various accompanying activities, health checks and food and drink options are available on race day. Custom medals and T-shirts can be ordered in advance. Participants can also look forward to finisher medals, aid stations, medical services and family activities. Registration is online via Köridő.hu, with favourable prices and early-bird registration options.

name: OK Trip Trail
description: OK Trip Trail is a race held in the beautiful surroundings of Ovčar Banja, known for its natural beauty and healthy lifestyle. The race brings together lovers of sport and nature, offering a unique opportunity to enjoy a challenging course through forested areas and mountain terrain. The Healthy Spirit Festival, under whose auspices the race is organized, promotes an active and healthy lifestyle in the heart of Serbia.
course_highlights: Trails through the forested and mountainous areas of Ovčar Banja
Natural surroundings with fresh air and beautiful views
Challenging terrain suited to trail running
additional: The event is part of the Healthy Spirit Festival, which highlights healthy living, sport, and outdoor activities.

name: Крос-триатлон „По стъпките на траките“
description: The “In the Footsteps of the Thracians” cross triathlon is the inaugural edition of a race offering a unique experience in the mystical Valley of the Thracian Kings, near Koprinka Reservoir in Kazanlak. Participants will take on challenging swimming, cycling, and running courses amid beautiful scenery and varied terrain. The event is suitable both for amateurs looking to test their strength and willpower and for those seeking outdoor fun. Organized by the Trayana-Triathlon Sports Club of Stara Zagora, the race promises unforgettable views and atmosphere.
course_highlights: 2 km swim along the sandy shores of Koprinka Reservoir
60 km cycling through the forests of Sredna Gora over rugged terrain
15 km run through the forest and along the reservoir shore, with panoramic views
additional: Cutoff times: swimming — 1:40 hours; cycling — 5:30 hours; running — 2:30 hours. Any time saved by a participant in one stage is added to the next. Participation is limited to people over 18. The day before the race, there is a children’s race for different age groups. Courses: 2 km swimming, 60 km cycling, 14 km running; registration at different prices; included: medals, aid stations, professional timing, medical support, bicycle service, prizes, and photos.

name: Витоша 100км
description: Vitosha 100 km is a mountain ultramarathon held around Vitosha Mountain in 9 stages, passing through picturesque villages and natural landmarks. The race offers a challenge for runners, cyclists, and duathletes, combining long distances with varied terrain. The organizers emphasize protecting nature and holding a waste-free race. Participants receive race packs and special surprises, and the event is supported by local partners and sponsors.
course_highlights: A 9-stage loop around Vitosha, passing through villages and natural landmarks
Mountain ultramarathon with varied terrain and elevation
Start and finish in front of Boyana Residence, Sofia
additional: Race numbers are distributed at the ALPI store in Sofia and at the start, up to 60 minutes before the race. The race emphasizes environmental protection: participants are encouraged to bring their own bottles and not to litter. A special SOFT FLASK 150ml for gels is available. The awards ceremony takes place on race day after the finish. The race includes running, cycling, and duathlon disciplines. The course includes remote parts of the mountain, with a total elevation gain of over 2,000 meters; the race takes place in Sofia and is part of a mountain ultramarathon and cycling event.

name: 10. Ócsai Pincesorfutás Radics József emlékére 4 / 12 / 24

description: The Ócsa Cellar Row Run in memory of József Radics is a community trail-running event that takes runners past landmarks in the town of Ócsa. The race is run on a 10.5 km course, which can be repeated for the longer distances of 21 km and 42 km. The event uses individual chip timing and aims to bring sport and community together in memory of József Radics. The start and finish are in front of the Egressy Gábor Leisure Centre, and the course includes a variety of paved and dirt paths.
course_highlights: The 10.5 km course passes Ócsa landmarks, including the Öreghegy cellar row and the Reformed Church
The 21 km distance consists of two laps, and the 42 km distance four laps, of the 10.5 km course
Varied terrain: paved streets and dirt paths; 100% trail running through the cellar row
additional: The race uses individual chip timing, recording both net and gross times. Placings are determined by gross time. Residents of Ócsa receive a discount on the entry fee upon presentation of proof of address. Entry is free for people born in 1960 or earlier. The race is limited to a maximum of 550 participants. The start and finish are on the street in front of the Egressy Gábor Leisure Centre. The event features multiple distances, including commemorative runs and community events in keeping with the local spirit; it is open to participants and takes place on varied terrain.

name: TRAIL RELAY BANSKÁ ŠTIAVNICA – VISEGRÁD
location: Banská Štiavnica, Banská Štiavnica District, Banská Bystrica Region, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 2026. február 1. és 2026. március 31. között 80 euró/csapattag illetve egyéni futó

tiers.label: tier_3

description: TRAIL RELAY BANSKÁ ŠTIAVNICA - VISEGRÁD is a 220 km trail relay race connecting the historic towns of Banská Štiavnica and Visegrád. The race consists of 18 stages that pass through the Štiavnica Mountains and Duna-Ipoly National Park, with abundant natural and cultural attractions along the way. Runners can take part in teams of different sizes or in individual categories, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them. The race aims to connect the two royal towns and showcase the region’s natural and historical heritage.
course_highlights: Passes through the Štiavnica Mountains and Duna-Ipoly National Park
18 stages, 8–16 km long, with varied terrain and difficulty
Historical and natural attractions, including Drégely Castle, Esztergom Basilica, and Prédikálószék
additional: The race is open to teams of 3–8 runners and individual runners. Teams take turns over 18 stages, each 8–16 km long. Individual runners may complete the full distance at their own risk and with their own support, and may use the refreshment stations. The course passes through protected natural areas and historical sites. The race route includes sections through Duna-Ipoly National Park and other nature reserves, highlighting both natural beauty and cultural heritage.

name: Tara Ultra Trail 2026
location: Nacionalni park Tara, Bajina Bašta, Serbia
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Ultra Trail 2026 is a mountain trail race held in Tara National Park, Bajina Bašta, on the first weekend of July. The race offers several distances suited to different fitness levels, from a vertical climb to an ultra-long 62 km course with significant elevation gain. The trails pass through hidden and scenic parts of Tara, giving runners an unforgettable nature experience and a challenge for body and mind. Alongside the races, an all-day outdoor festival and accompanying cultural events take place at the finish, creating a unique atmosphere for participants and visitors alike.
course_highlights: The TUT 62 course runs from Rača Monastery through hidden parts of Tara National Park to Bajina Bašta, with 2,600 m of elevation gain
The Crnjeskovo and Sokolarica viewpoints and the Rača Canyon offer spectacular views during the race
Varied terrain includes singletrack, gravel roads, paved sections, and technical descents
additional: Registration opens at midnight on January 1, 2026. Participants under 18 cannot take part in TUT 62, and children under 14 may run only when accompanied by a parent. An all-day outdoor festival and the Bašta Fest short film festival take place at the finish. The children’s race (ages 4–12) is free and adapted for the youngest competitors. Online registration opens on January 1, 2026, and the races include various distances and categories, with activities for all ages and ITRA points.

name: Balkan Mountain and Trail Running Championships
organizer: Balkan Mountaineering Union (BMU), Planinarski savez Srbije (PSS), Tara Ultra Trail, Planinarski klub Tara
description: The first Balkan Mountain and Trail Running Championships will take place from July 2 to 4, 2026, in Tara National Park and Bajina Bašta, Serbia. The competition features four races: Mountain Uphill, Mountain Classic, Mountain Trail, and U18 Mountain Classic, bringing together the best mountain runners in the Balkans. The varied and challenging courses offer spectacular scenery and technical climbs, providing a true challenge and an opportunity to enjoy nature. The organizers are the Balkan Mountaineering Union, the Mountaineering Association of Serbia, Tara Ultra Trail, and Mountaineering Club Tara. We invite all runners to join us and celebrate mountain and trail running in the heart of Serbia.
course_highlights: Mountain Uphill: 6 km with over 1,000 m of elevation gain, finishing at the Sjenič viewpoint with panoramic views of Tara
Mountain Classic: 13.6 km with 550 m of elevation gain, starting at Rača Monastery, passing through the Rača Canyon, and finishing in Bajina Bašta
Mountain Trail: 36 km with about 1,900 m of elevation gain, a technically challenging course with two climbs to the Tara plateau and spectacular viewpoints
additional: The races are for runners born in 2008 or earlier for Mountain Uphill and Mountain Classic, while Mountain Trail is for runners born in 2006 or earlier. Mountain Uphill is the only race that neither starts at Rača Monastery nor finishes in Bajina Bašta. The courses include technical single-track sections, fast descents, and challenging climbs, with final sections suited to a strong finish. Several race categories, including U18, focus on mountain terrain and natural beauty; the event is organized by regional and local mountaineering and sports organizations.

name: Tara Ultra Trail
location: Nacionalni park Tara, Tara Mountain, Serbia
organizer: Udruženje Tara Ultra i PK Tara
description: Tara Ultra Trail is a mountain trail race held in Tara National Park, Serbia, on the first weekend of July. The race offers several distances suited to different levels of runners, from a vertical climb to a 62 km ultradistance with significant elevation gain. The routes pass through hidden and beautiful parts of the mountain, offering unforgettable scenery and challenges. In addition to the races, an outdoor festival and accompanying events for all ages and fitness levels take place at the finish. The event is an opportunity to experience the mountain in all its beauty and grandeur.
course_highlights: A 62 km course with 2,600 m of cumulative elevation gain through Tara National Park
Spectacular viewpoints such as Crnjeskovo, Sokolarica, and the Rača Canyon
Varied terrain including technical singletrack sections, gravel roads, and asphalt
additional: The children’s race (ages 4–12) is free and tailored to the youngest participants, with parents and guardians welcome to join them. An all-day outdoor festival and accompanying cultural events are held at the finish in Bajina Bašta, including the short film festival “Bašta Fest.” All races award ITRA points and count toward the ITRA National League. Multiple distances, Balkan Championship, outdoor festival, children’s race, registration via prijavise.net

name: Carpathia Trails
distance_verbose: 100 km, 58 km, 57 km, 50 km, Maraton, 36 km, 23 km, 5 km
description: Carpathia Trails este o cursă de alergare montană ce se desfășoară pe 4 iulie 2026 în Complex Cheile Grădiștei, Fundata, traversând trei masive muntoase: Munții Bucegi, Munții Leaota și Piatra Craiului. Evenimentul oferă șase opțiuni de curse individuale, cu distanțe variind de la 6 km la ultra-maraton de 102 km, potrivite pentru toate nivelurile de experiență. Participanții se pot bucura de peisaje spectaculoase și o experiență unică în natură, într-un cadru prietenos și bine organizat. Înscrierile sunt limitate și se fac online până pe 23 iunie 2026.
course_highlights: Trasee ce străbat trei munți: Bucegi, Leaota și Piatra Craiului
Distanțe variate de la 6 km la ultra-maraton 102 km
Peisaje naturale spectaculoase în zona Cheile Grădiștei
additional: Startul se va da în aceeași zi, 4 iulie 2026, din Complex Cheile Grădiștei, epicentrul evenimentului. Înscrierile sunt limitate și se pot face online. Organizatorul poate acorda wildcarduri unor sportivi recunoscuți. Evenimentul este susținut de donațiile participanților, sponsori și parteneri. Codul de conduită este obligatoriu pentru toți participanții pentru a proteja traseele și a asigura siguranța. Participarea se face prin formular online, cu limite de înscrieri și posibilitatea de wildcard pentru sportivi recunoscuți. Evenimentul are loc pe 4 iulie 2026 în Cheile Grădiștei, Fundata, Brașov.

name: Legendele Nemirei
description: Legendele Nemirei este un concurs de alergare montană desfășurat în Slănic Moldova, ce oferă trasee spectaculoase prin păduri răcoroase și pe culmile masivului Nemira. Participanții se bucură de un traseu bine marcat, cu peisaje naturale sălbatice și provocări alpine, potrivit pentru alergători cu experiență. Evenimentul este apreciat pentru organizarea atentă, voluntarii dedicați și atmosfera prietenoasă, fiind o experiență memorabilă pentru iubitorii de alergare montană.
course_highlights: Trasee prin păduri umbroase și zone alpine cu peisaje naturale sălbatice
Marcaj turistic în proporție de 90% și semnalizare suplimentară în zonele dificile
Diferențe de nivel semnificative, cu urcări și coborâri spectaculoase
additional: Traseele includ maraton, semimaraton și cros, cu diferențe pozitive de nivel între 700 m și 2400 m. Startul se face din Parcul Central al stațiunii Slănic Moldova. Traseele sunt în proporție de 80-90% alergabile, cu porțiuni de drum forestier, poteci alpine și zone accidentate. Organizatorii recomandă experiență montană și echipament adecvat. Există și o cursă pentru copii pentru a încuraja alergarea în natură. Evenimentul include și trasee pentru copii, cu accent pe turismul ecologic și implicarea comunității, oferind informații despre înscrieri, cazare și trasee.

name: Cozia Mountain Run
description: Cozia Mountain Run este o competiție de alergare montană ce se desfășoară în Masivul Cozia, pe malul stâng al Oltului, în stațiunea balneoclimaterică Călimănești-Căciulata. Evenimentul, organizat de Asociația Pegas Triatlon Club cu sprijinul autorităților locale, promovează alergarea montană, tradițiile locale și strângerea de fonduri umanitare. Participanții parcurg trei trasee montane cu caracter dificil, neamenajate, care necesită experiență și abilități montane. Atmosfera este una prietenoasă și energizantă, iar după cursă toți alergătorii sunt invitați la masa de prânz la Mănăstirea Turnu.
course_highlights: Trasee montane neamenajate cu diferențe de nivel semnificative (ex. 30 km cu 2000 m diferență de nivel)
Trecerea prin localități, pășuni alpine, zone împădurite și creste montane
Trasee ce includ segmente cu corzi fixe și teren accidentat, necesitând experiență montană
additional: Predarea numerelor de start se face în două etape: vineri seara și sâmbătă dimineața. Startul pentru traseele Cozia (30 km) și Stănișoara (21 km) este la ora 08:00, iar pentru traseul Turnu (4 km) la ora 09:00. Există un timp limită de 8 ore pentru traseele Cozia și Stănișoara. Crosul copiilor se desfășoară în Campingul Mănăstirii Turnu cu start la ora 16:00, iar înscrierea copiilor este gratuită. După cursă, toți participanții sunt invitați la masa de prânz după Sfânta Liturghie la Mănăstirea Turnu. Trasee montane, limită de timp de 8 ore, pentru participanți peste 18 ani, accent pe alergare și drumeție, promovarea frumuseților naturale și culturale locale

name: IX. Holdfény Éjszakai Félmaraton és Családi Sportnap
location: Népkert sor, Szeged, Csongrád County, Hungary
description: The 9th Moonlight Night Half Marathon and Family Sports Day is a charity running event in Szeged, welcoming runners for a night half marathon. The event also serves as a family-friendly sports day where participants can enjoy the pleasures of community sport. It takes place on Népkert sor, an ideal setting for both running and family activities. The event is traditionally popular, with more than 1,100 participants.
course_highlights: Night half marathon distance
Family-friendly sports day activities
The green surroundings of Népkert sor, Szeged
additional: The event is held for charity and is organized as a family sports day, offering night running. More than 1,100 participants took part in a previous year. The event takes place on Népkert sor in Szeged, and the program includes the half marathon and the family sports day.

description: The 6th Tapolca Rockwool Trail is a scenic running race through the beautiful landscapes of the Balaton Uplands, around Tapolca-Diszel. The route is 80% dirt roads, cart tracks and trails, offering runners varied terrain and exceptional views. There are five different distances, and those up to 22 km can also be completed as hikes. The race welcomes participants with unique finisher medals, refreshment stations and a hot meal, while the organizers aim to make it an environmentally friendly, green event.
course_highlights: 80% dirt roads, cart tracks and trails
Beautiful views across the Balaton Uplands
Refreshment stations, including at wine cellars
additional: Every runner who starts receives a unique finisher medal. Refreshments are available along the route and in the start/finish area: water, cola, isotonic drinks, fruit, pretzels, wafers and lard spread on bread. A hot meal is served at the finish, with a meat-free option. The race is a “green” event, so participants should bring their own cup or bottle. Chip timing; the chip deposit is 1,000 HUF. At the awards ceremony, the top three women and men receive medals, trophies and gifts from sponsors. Online registration; refreshments and food provided; environmentally friendly event; registration fee; green approach.

description: The Teliholdfutam is a night running race in Esztergom, following a scenic route through Castle Hill, Víziváros and along the riverside cycle path. The race offers three distances: 4 km, 10 km and 15 km; the 15 km route also takes in Prímás Island. Runners must use a headlamp or another light source, as some sections of the course are unlit. The event is organised by the Esztergom Futóművek Amateur Sports Association and is also a points-collecting event in the Ötpróba program.
course_highlights: Route through Esztergom’s Castle Hill, Víziváros and riverside cycle path
15 km distance passing through Prímás Island
Cobblestone sections and unlit stretches of cycle path
additional: A working headlamp or other light source is mandatory. The participant limit is 200 per distance. The event is part of the Ötpróba program, where the 4 km distance earns 1 point, the 10 km distance 2 points and the 15 km distance 3 points. For online entries, the invoice is sent as an attachment to the confirmation email; for on-site entries, it is sent within 5 days after the race. T-shirt sizes and an ECO entry option without a T-shirt, with an old medal, are available. Race details include course conditions, entry information and event rules; the event is also part of the Ötpróba program.

name: Troyan Run
location: Troyan, Troyan Municipality, Lovech Province, Bulgaria
distance_verbose: 70 km, Маратон, 28 km, 12 km, 5 km, 3000 метра
description: TroyanRun is a mountain running event held in the Troyan Balkan, dedicated to the work of Vasil Levski. The race offers routes of varying difficulty, suitable for both professionals and mountain running enthusiasts. It is organized by the Troyan in the Future Association, which works to promote the area’s historical and natural heritage and encourage a healthy lifestyle through sport. The event also includes a street art festival and charitable initiatives.
course_highlights: Routes of varying lengths: 3 km, 6 km, 12 km, 28 km, 42 km and 70 km, with varying elevation gain
Mountain terrain in the Troyan Balkan, featuring natural and historical landmarks
Open to both professionals and enthusiasts
additional: Race packs are collected on site, with priority given to participants in the longer distances. Participants must carry their race number, a water bottle or hydration system (minimum 500 ml), and a mobile phone with the organizers’ number. The program includes a technical briefing and an awards ceremony. Multiple distances, historical theme, mountain running, charitable initiatives, routes with panoramic views, events promoting an active lifestyle

name: Вършец ултра
description: Varshets Ultra is a mountain running event offering a range of distances suitable for experienced ultramarathon runners as well as beginners and children. The event takes place in the beautiful natural surroundings of Varshets, with the start in front of Hotel Medicus. Participants can choose from an ultra-distance of 48 km and shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. The race combines sport, nature, and the opportunity for an active holiday in the national resort of Varshets.
course_highlights: Mountain running with a range of distances
Start in front of Hotel Medicus in the town of Varshets
Routes through scenic natural surroundings
additional: Race packs can be collected at Varshets Municipality. Distances: ultra 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. Dates: July 12–13, 2026. Distances: 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners. Start at Hotel Medicus; online registration.

name: Камчийски пясъци
description: Kamchiyski Sands is a unique running event taking place on July 4, 2026, along Bulgaria’s longest beach between Kamchia Resort and Shkorpilovtsi. The course is entirely on sand and includes crossing the mouth of the Kamchia River, with rescue equipment and aids provided. The event offers two main distances—10 km and 21.1 km—as well as a 2.2 km children’s run. It is organized by the Green Step club, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and adventure sports.
course_highlights: The course is entirely on sand and includes crossing the mouth of the Kamchia River.
The distances are 10 km and 21.1 km, with aid stations approximately every 5 km.
Runners can run barefoot, and rescue equipment is provided for the river crossing.
additional: The start is in the evening. Race numbers are distributed from 15:00, and baggage storage is available. The time limits are 4 hours for 21.1 km and 3 hours 30 minutes for 10 km. Children can take part in the 2.2 km children’s run for free. Participants must bring a water container for the aid stations. Timing uses RFID chips. In unfavorable conditions, the river crossing may be made by boats provided by the organizers. Registration is available online and on site. Fees can be paid via EasyPay or ePay. Accompaniment is available, and children under 7 may participate with an accompanying adult.

name: HAAS MARATON VÁLTÓ
organizer: Tatai Tömegsport és Tájfutó Honvéd Sportegyesület
description: The HAAS Marathon Relay is a traditional relay race organized by the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association. The race combines the excitement of relay running with the beauty of nature, giving participants the chance to test their strength on varied terrain around Tata. The event has a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere and offers an enjoyable experience for spectators as well as runners. It is open to sports enthusiasts and amateur runners alike, and is an important event in local sports life.
course_highlights: Relay race on varied terrain around Tata
Nature-close course with forest and agricultural sections
Welcoming, friendly race atmosphere
additional: The race is organized by the Tata Mass Sports and Orienteering Honvéd Sports Association, which supports several sports. The race is part of Sprint Running Club events, and traditionally several divisions take part in organizing it. Maps and past results are available on the website, but no specific prices or start times are listed on the page provided. In addition to the relay race, the event offers other sporting activities; detailed registration and participation information is available on the organizer’s website.

name: Treska Trail
description: Join an adventurous hiking tour from Kežman Mountain Houses to the summit of Treska on Kopaonik. This short 650-meter trail leads to an impressive peak at 1,622 meters above sea level, with beautiful panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and valleys. The trail is well marked and suitable for all guests. The ascent takes about 30 minutes, offering a chance to enjoy nature and take photos. Organized tours with transport to the trailhead are available to all accommodation guests.
course_highlights: A 52-meter ascent from 1,570 m to 1,622 m above sea level
Panoramic views of Pančićev Vrh, Radočelo, Golija, and the surrounding mountains
The trail is well marked and safe for hiking
additional: Transport to the trailhead is arranged in the host’s van for accommodation guests. The return trip takes about 30 minutes in total. The tour is available only to guests of Kežman Mountain Houses. Participants can expect a guided tour, a short walk with spectacular views, a steep ascent, and a well-marked trail.

name: 48. Trka oko Avale
description: The Around Avala Athletics Race is a traditional event organized by the Athletics Veterans Association of Serbia. The race takes place in Avala’s beautiful surroundings and brings together runners of different ages and fitness levels. It offers an opportunity for sportsmanship and to promote athletics among veterans and recreational runners. The start and finish are at an attractive location, and the course offers both a challenge and the chance to enjoy nature.
course_highlights: Course around Mount Avala
Natural surroundings and woodland scenery
Race suited to veterans and recreational runners
additional: Participants can expect races over various distances, including a half marathon, with the possibility of scoring points toward national and international series. Registration is open to a large number of competitors, and the event is supported by local sponsors and the community.

name: Вършец рън
description: Varshets Run and Varshets Ultra is a mountain running event offering a range of distances suitable for experienced runners, beginners, and children. The event takes place in the scenic resort town of Varshets, with the start in front of Hotel Medicus. The courses include a 48 km ultra distance, as well as shorter routes of 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners, offering opportunities for participants of different levels. Registration is through the runbulgaria.org platform, and race packs can be collected at the Varshets Municipality.
course_highlights: Mountain running with a 48 km ultra distance
Short mountain routes of 11.6 km and 5.9 km
A 1 km distance for children and beginners
additional: The start is in front of Hotel Medicus. Race packs can be collected at the Varshets Municipality. Registration is through the runbulgaria.org platform. Distances: 48 km, 11.6 km, 5.9 km, and 1 km for children and beginners; start in front of Hotel Medicus; registration at www.runbulgaria.org

name: Zalău Ultra Trail
description: Zalău Ultra Trail este o competiție de alergare montană ce se desfășoară pe parcursul a trei zile în inima Munților Sălajului. Evenimentul oferă o varietate de curse pentru toate nivelurile, de la copii la alergători experimentați, inclusiv o cursă ultra de 103 km cu o diferență de nivel de peste 5000 m. ZUT este mai mult decât o competiție, fiind o platformă care unește atleți, comunitatea locală și natura, promovând spiritul de aventură și respectul pentru mediul înconjurător. Traseele sunt provocatoare și spectaculoase, oferind o experiență autentică de trail running în peisaje naturale impresionante.
course_highlights: Traseu ULTRA de 103 km cu 5255 m diferență de nivel
Puncte de alimentare și control bine echipate pe traseu
Diversitate de curse: de la 2,5 km pentru copii până la ultra de 103 km
additional: Evenimentul se desfășoară pe 3 zile, cu curse multiple adaptate diferitelor niveluri de pregătire. Cursa Last Man Standing este o competiție specială de anduranță cu ture de 6.7 km la fiecare oră, eliminând participanții care nu termină în timp. Există categorii de premii pentru copii și cursele Cross. Echipamentul obligatoriu este specificat în regulament, iar punctele de alimentare oferă apă, isotonic, fructe și mâncare caldă pe traseul ultra. Multiple race distanțe, inclusiv curse pentru copii și evenimente caritabile; accent pe promovarea valorilor locale și a spiritului comunitar; evenimentul are și o componentă de sensibilizare ecologică.

name: Stâna de Vale Trail Race
description: Stâna de Vale Trail Race este o competiție de alergare montană ce se desfășoară în peisajele spectaculoase ale Munților Carpați, în stațiunea Stâna de Vale, județul Bihor. Evenimentul face parte din circuitul EMA Off-Road Running 2026 și oferă curse pentru toate nivelurile, de la trasee pentru începători până la ultramaratoane montane solicitante. Participanții se pot bucura de trasee bine marcate, asistență completă pe parcurs și o atmosferă prietenoasă după cursă. Weekendul de concurs include și o cursă verticală de 8 km, o cursă clasică de 11 km și o cursă lungă de 33 km cu diferențe mari de nivel.
course_highlights: Traseu montan de 33 km cu 1500 m diferență de nivel pozitivă, cu secțiuni tehnice și priveliști panoramice
Traseu de 11 km potrivit pentru începători și alergători intermediari, prin păduri și dealuri domoale
Cursă verticală de 8 km cu 1100 m diferență de nivel, cu urcare continuă și solicitantă
additional: Evenimentul se desfășoară pe 10-11 iulie 2026, cu ridicarea pachetelor de concurs la Hotel Iadolina, Stâna de Vale. Cursa Vertical 8K începe vineri la ora 10:00, iar cursele de 33 km și 11 km încep sâmbătă la 08:30 și 09:30. Organizatorii oferă masă după cursă și o petrecere de după festivitatea de premiere. Participarea în circuitul EMA este condiționată de deținerea unei licențe valide pentru categoria de vârstă 35-79 ani. Traseele sunt în teren montan, iar evenimentul include cronometrare. Participanții pot alege între două distanțe pentru a se potrivi nivelului lor de pregătire.

name: Jadovnički Ultramaraton 2026
description: Jadovnik Ultramarathon 2026 is a unique trail event in western Serbia, bringing together nature lovers and fans of endurance and extreme races. It takes place on July 10 and 11 in Prijepolje, with the start and finish at the Cultural Center Plaza. All courses are new and do not repeat those from the previous edition, and the races cater to different fitness levels and runner categories. Participants receive a race packet with a T-shirt, promotional materials, and a finisher’s medal, and the organizers also provide support with accommodation and meals.
course_highlights: Three races of different distances: Maxi (60.9 km), Midi (24.8 km), Mini (14.6 km)
The courses are entirely new and do not repeat those from the previous ultramarathon
Time limits: Maxi 12h, Midi 7h, Mini 5h
additional: The race packet includes a T-shirt (size guaranteed for entries paid by June 20, 2026), promotional materials from the Prijepolje Tourist Organization, finisher’s medals for everyone who completes the race, and medals and trophies for category winners. Free accommodation is available in the gymnasium of “Valter” Elementary School (sleeping bags are required). The organizer reserves the right to make course adjustments, with timely notice. Participants can expect details about registration, medals, T-shirts, and timing on the official platforms. The event also includes services such as timekeeping and event promotion.

name: Predeal Forest Run
description: Predeal Forest Run este un eveniment de alergare montană ce se desfășoară în Predeal, Brașov, pe 11 iulie 2026. Evenimentul oferă cinci trasee de trail running potrivite pentru toate nivelurile de pregătire, de la începători la alergători experimentați, cu distanțe variind de la 13 km până la 38 km. Traseele trec prin păduri, poteci montane și zone cu peisaje spectaculoase, oferind o experiență completă de alergare montană. Evenimentul este cunoscut pentru atmosfera prietenoasă și comunitatea activă de alergători, fiind o ocazie excelentă de a descoperi frumusețile muntelui Piatra Mare.
course_highlights: Trasee 100% trail run prin pădure și poteci montane
Urcări provocatoare, inclusiv peste 500 m diferență de nivel pe 4 km la K24
Peisaje spectaculoase de la Poiana Stanei Pietricica, Vf. Piatra Mare și Cabana Garbova
additional: Evenimentul include cinci probe: K13 Cros, K24 Semimaraton, K32 Piatra Mare, K38 Maraton și Family Run (necompetitiv). Startul se dă de la baza pârtiilor Clăbucet. Traseele sunt marcate cu bandă galbenă cu logo Predeal Forest Run roșu și sunt asistate de voluntari. Timpi limita și puncte de alimentare sunt stabilite pentru probele competitive. Kitul de participare va fi anunțat ulterior. Participanții pot înscrie la diverse categorii de curse, iar evenimentul promovează o cauză socială. Detalii despre înscriere și reguli sunt disponibile pe site-ul oficial.

name: VII. Csillagok útján… éjszakai futás
description: The 7th Csillagok útján… night run is a unique running experience at Balatonboglár’s Platán Beach, where runners and walkers are welcomed on July 11 in a summer setting on the shores of Lake Balaton. The new venue offers a wider start-finish corridor, a firm surface throughout, and full street lighting along the route. Participants can choose from 3.5, 7, and 10.5 km distances, while walking and a 500-meter children’s distance are also available. The event warmly welcomes all ages and running levels to experience the magic of running at night together.
course_highlights: Balatonboglár’s Platán Beach in a beautiful lakeside setting
A wide start-finish corridor and a firm surface throughout
Street lighting along the entire route for a night-running experience
additional: Walking is also available on the 3.5 km distance, and children can test their strength over 500 meters. Street lighting along the entire route supports safe night running. The new venue offers a wider start-finish corridor and a firm surface. The event is part of the summer events on Lake Balaton, and the organizers aim to increase interest in active leisure activities in the region.

name: DRÁVA FÉLMARATON
location: Barcs, Városháza, Barcs, Somogy County, Hungary
description: The Dráva Half Marathon is a traditional 21-kilometer race between Barcs and Heresznye, held for the fifth time. Runners from several counties take part, and men and women compete in separate categories. The course is varied, and record times have been set in previous years, reflecting the race’s competitive nature and popularity. The event is organized by the local Dráva Running Club and the Heresznye municipality, creating a friendly yet competitive atmosphere for participants.
course_highlights: 21-kilometer course between Barcs and Heresznye
Varied route that has seen record times
Runners from six counties take part in the race
additional: The event includes several sports, including running, hiking, and cycling, and the races are usually held in July between Barcs and Heresznye.

name: KÖCSI-TÓ FUTÓVERSENY
description: The Köcsi Lake running event is a traditional race with a friendly, family atmosphere, held near Balatonalmádi-Káptalanfüred, in the scenic surroundings of Köcsi Lake. Everyone who wants to run or walk is warmly welcome to enjoy the natural setting and the community sporting experience. The event is organized by the Marathon Mass Sports and Environmental Protection Association, which is committed to sport and environmental protection. The race offers several distances, so everyone can find a challenge that suits them.
course_highlights: A nature-rich course around Köcsi Lake
A friendly, community atmosphere
Several distances for different age groups
additional: Results are available for the 1 km, 6 km, and 12 km distances, broken down by age group. The event is organized by the Marathon Mass Sports and Environmental Protection Association, which also supports several health and environmental projects. Photos are available for participants on the website. Multiple distances for children and adults, refreshment facilities, the opportunity to swim at the beach, finisher medals.

name: Jadovnički ultramaraton
description: The Jadovnik Ultramarathon was first organized by the Jadovnik Citizens’ Association on the mountain of the same name. The race aims to highlight the beauty and rich flora and fauna of Mount Jadovnik, which has so far been little known to the public. This ultramarathon offers runners a unique opportunity to experience the challenge and special appeal of running in unspoiled nature. The organizers hope to preserve and promote the mountain through sport and community.
course_highlights: The course runs through Mount Jadovnik, rich in flora and fauna
The race takes place in unspoiled nature with a distinctive mountain setting
A unique opportunity to discover a lesser-known mountain in Serbia
additional: Participants must carry mandatory equipment. The race is limited to 100 runners, and the route includes forest roads and paved sections.

name: Национален шампионат под 20 г.
description: The Under-20 National Championships, organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, is a prestigious competition that brings together Bulgaria’s best young athletes. Held at a stadium in Sofia, it offers young athletes an opportunity to develop and showcase their talent in athletics. The competition is part of the BAF’s 2026 sports calendar and is held under the auspices of the leading organization in Bulgarian athletics, which has a long-standing tradition and international recognition.
course_highlights: Stadium competition in Sofia
Participation by the best athletes under 20
Organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation, which has a long-standing tradition
additional: The event is part of the national youth sports development program and will bring together young athletes from across the country.

name: TRI Legend Batak 2026
location: Язовир Батак, Батак, Бургаска област, България
distance_verbose: 50 miles, 50 km, Полумаратон, 10 km, 1.9 km, 0.9 km
